notes.title: Manchester Airport Commuter - Update Notes (4th July 2025)
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

This morning, we shared an update to support the recently released Manchester Airport Commuter route from the ATS team, prioritising the alignment of game builds across all platforms, and fixing initial community-reported issues from the launch. We've had a full confirmed list of changes, which also includes additional highlights we wanted to share, so please view the full patch notes list below.

Additionally, we wanted to share a big thank you to the ATS team for their support, communication working with our groups, and dedication to monitoring feedback since the release. They'll also be livestreaming the add-on tonight, so if you're hoping to get further insights from the ATS team on the release and details about the development of their first route in Train Sim World, be sure to join in!
Please note, the livestreamed content may not be suitable for all audiences.


Alan Thomson Simulation - YouTube

Alan Thomson Simulation - Twitch


This update is already live across all platforms. Please share any feedback in our dedicated Manchester Airport Commuter feedback thread.

Full Changelog
Manchester Airport Commuter


Aligned the builds across all platforms to the most up-to-date version

Fixed a number of terrain related issues around Manchester Piccadilly, Stockport and Heaton Chapel

Fixed various issues relating to the Sunday timetable

Added TSW5 track shadow implementation

Added various lighting improvements

Added speakers to lamp posts at Manchester Piccadilly

Fixed several material issues with the station building at Burnage

Fixed foot step audio on concreted area at Burnage

Fixed an issue with the lamp material at Manchester Piccadilly

Fixed CCTV and PIS systems at Manchester Piccadilly

Fixed an issue with missing OHLE at Manchester Airport (Xbox)

Fixed missing textures at Stockport Viaduct (Xbox)

Fixed the ballast mound at Heaton Chapel

Fixed passenger deboarding issues at Stockport

Fixed an issue with Class 350 pantographs to now default to raised

Fixed an issue with intermittent crashing and performance issues on console

notes.title: Train Sim World 5 Game Update - June 23rd
notes.content:
Hey everyone,



Today we have a major update coming to Train Sim World 5, which brings a huge range of improvements across multiple add-ons, as well as the core game.

Additionally, this patch will bring the Koln-Aachen timetable update to PS5 and Epic Games players, adding new services, layers and boosting the timetable, a large change-list of new features and improvements for the Expert DB BR 101 & IC Steuerwagen add-on, as well as the first stage in our core memory optimisation improvements, which you can read about in more detail below.



An Update on Memory Improvements

Following on from our continued discussions around performance and memory, we’ve been able to make minor improvements to performance over the course of our monthly updates, but alongside the patch we’re sharing today, we’re making a significant next step, the first of a two-part release, to improve the robustness and stability of the core game by further reduce crashing, with the intention of ensuring game sessions can be enjoyed and completed.

Our testing for this patch has shown success in reducing crashes, and additionally, some members of our beta team have reported anecdotal improvements to framerates and smoothness. Please note, some routes may also see some minor improvements for textures, reducing the blurriness that appears, but this was not the focus of this update, and will be our goal moving forward.

In the advanced settings, you will now find three new advanced settings, that allow you to toggle if custom liveries, custom formations or substitutions appear, providing flexibility to your experience, and additional ways to manage memory.

This patch was just the first half of a two-part memory update, with the next part aimed at addressing a concern we've seen where players aren't seeing some of their layered content on particular routes. This should provide access to all of your owned layers, an issue which is directly related to memory.

As we look to the future, now that stability has been addressed, our focus will prioritise tackling blurry texture and visual quality. Thank you for your continued patience while our team works hard to ensure the best experience possible.

For a full list of changes in today’s patch, see the notes below, and if you experience any issues following the update, please alert our team.


Highlights
Core

•    Improved button layout formatting to make bound keys and control names more readable.

•    Added an advanced settings section for consoles to enable or disable vehicles from other route content being used for AI trains.

notes.title: BR 194 / E94 Railtour Pack – Coming Soon!
notes.content:
The Story So Far:
We've already talked a little bit about TSG’s latest loco Add-on following the release of Mittenwaldbahn earlier in the year.

This includes:

First announcement in the April 2025 Roadmap

Further details and screenshots in the May 2025 Roadmap

Please note that this add-on will be released on Gen 9 (Xbox Series S|X & PS5) and PC platforms only.


Rolling StockDRG BR 194 locomotive
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/74d6500016e44d37a5e6a80a0162aacf88e49f44.jpg"]

This style of locomotive – the iconic ‘Krokodil’ - was first introduced to Train Sim World with the Mittenwaldbahn Add-on in the form of the ÖBB 1020. The distinctive shape dates back to over a century ago, with this type of locomotive arriving slightly later in the 1940s and 50s.



The DRG BR 194 is an older variant than the ÖBB 1020, as TSG explained in the April Roadmap:

“When the ÖBB took on the E94s to form the ÖBB 1020s, over time they made a significant number of modernisations and improvements to the locos to keep them relevant and suit local requirements. In backdating the 1020 into the BR 194 these modifications have had to be removed leaving a somewhat cruder locomotive.”



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/6ed3ba111611cdea5f5e865ad95cf13f030a8be5.jpg"]

Differences can be seen both inside and out, with the DRG variant seen in a plain dark green livery, rather than the ÖBB red. The roof and windows, but also components like cooling pipes, vents, and lights, also have visual differences.

In the cab, the technology is visibly dated with less electrical components and switches, a shorter instrument display and even an older style of telephone!

A more comprehensive list of changes includes:

Air System Modifications including a weaker compressor, differing air tank capacity and locations within the system and non-centralised brake frame (Goods passenger valves and Triple Valves are located on the bogies instead of in the machine room for example)

Train Brake Valves are now Knorr Nr.10 manually lapped brake valves instead of the Oerlikon FV4 Self lapping Valves.

Indusi i54 instead of i60 (functionally the same, but no ability to change modes).

Different Pantographs and their control system. As modelled, we only have a single contract strip on each pantograph so both pantographs have to be raised typically. The Control of the MCB and pantos is done via a single valve in each cab, with an air valve in the Number 1 cab to select which pantograph is to be used. There is always a hand pump to be used to raise the pantograph in the event of there being no main reservoir pressure to raise it, to then allow the main compressor to run.

Different Lamp Systems, instead of built into the vehicle's body, are semi-permanent lamps with red filter levers on the side to change the aspect.

Various cosmetic changes including changes to the vents, removal of the snowploughs, roofline changes, cab windows, underframes, bonnets and more.

Changes to the Overload system requiring the driver to go into the machine room to reset in the event of an overload being tripped

Weaker Electric Brake comparative to how the 1020 was before the last update if not marginally weaker.


E94 Railtour locomotive
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/aad2e9df4b745b1862aef505f17bd3da7fb1aada.jpg"]

Also included is a more modern rail tour variant of the E94 in the form of the individual number 088, which runs rail tours to this day. Developing the Add-on was done with invaluable support of the Elektrische Zugförderung Württemberg, who will also receive a portion of the proceeds from this pack.

Originally built in 1943, this specific locomotive received major modifications in 1970 to become an ÖBB 1020 and continued service until 1994. After an extensive restoration, it was brought back to operational condition in 2013 and is now proudly maintained by EZW. Today, it still runs on both rail tours and regular services whenever an additional locomotive is needed.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/8b7b8370327436282efe13e894fb0874834b1943.jpg"]

TSG also stated in the May Roadmap:

“From the very beginning, their passionate team has provided us with original drawings and answered every technical question we had. Groups like EZW are the reason these 82-year-old locomotives are still alive and running today. Without their help, we wouldn’t have been able to capture the authentic sounds or gather the detailed information necessary to recreate these locomotives so faithfully.”


Byg 516 Umbauwagen Coaches
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/106580e99b11fcec59d701462d707b3577159c87.jpg"]

Including in the pack are ageing pre-war passenger coaches: “Umbauwagen”.

After the Second World War, German railways had a lack of coaching stock and therefore opted to rebuild old, pre-war coaches. "Umbauwagen" translates to "rebuild coach".



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/1c007b172e207590662d8ceb0bcae7559780836f.jpg"]

Over 6,500 of these coaches were in service at one point. They were withdrawn in the 2000s.


Gbs, Es50 and Falns freight wagons
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7421e5d7121b8d6771036b9b0841391df3cd25dd.jpg"]

For period freight services, a selection of new and reliveried freight wagons are included in the pack. The Gbs wagon is new to Train Sim World, whereas the Es50 and Falns have been seen before. The Falns comes in a new DBB livery.

The Gbs freight wagon is an iconic box car, which these days has been generally replaced by Habbins type wagons. It is found largely on heritage railways, used for storage, and was a staple wagon from the 1950s to 2000s.


Timetable services and additional gameplay
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/026ce0be550abfe954ae5710b98668cb21df32ce.jpg"]
New 1984 Linke Rheinstrecke Timetable


Players with the Linke Rheinstrecke route Add-on will be able to make use of a new 1984 timetable that is unlocked with the BR 194 loco Add-on.

This timetable is best experienced with a full complement of period locomotives and stock which are layered in from other Train Sim World Add-ons.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/9b79706f95c75a44d9d423d3286c9834e6e677a3.jpg"]

These are:

Linke Rheinstrecke

Mittenwaldbahn

Niddertalbahn

DB BR 218 loco Add-on

This content will be available in the form of a Bundle, available on Steam. We’ll provide more details of this bundle around release of the E94 loco Add-on.

The 1984 timetable will have a small number of additional playable services over the original timetable, set in 1997. However, there will be a significant increase in AI traffic with hundreds of additional AI services visible at both ends of the route.

Unique special services will be included, as well as local freight and repositioning movements. Long distance traffic will feature courtesy of content from the Mittenwaldbahn route Add-on. This increase in services means that some trains will have to wait for others!

There have also been a number of general improvements made to the Linke Rheinstrecke route, mainly focussed on scenery and water textures.

In the run up to release, the DB BR 218 will receive a new livery that can be used in this timetable or via Free Roam. We’ll share more news on this in the relevant Patch Notes.


Railtour services on Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/473f1acff66848978dcb89146daabe315052c304.jpg"]Unlock the Mastery Scenery Tile in Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn and use Free Roam to host the E94 in this engine shed, as depict here.



For a more contemporary experience, the E94 088 can be operated as rail tour services in two Scenarios for the Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn route.

Timetabled rail tour services are planned to be added to the route in the future.


Scenarios and Free Roam
Two Scenarios will be playable on both Linke Rheinstrecke and Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn.

Players can also make use of Free Roam and Scenario Planner to run custom rail tour services across any route in their collection. In real life, the locomotive has been seen hauling more contemporary stock such as Dostos and has been throughout Germany during its time in preservation.

Train Sim World 5: BR194 / E94 Railtour Pack will release on 24th June for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for €24.99/£19.99/$24.99

Find out more about Train Sim World 5 by following @trainsimworld on Twitter/X, Bluesky, Instagram, Threads, Facebook, YouTube, Twitch, and TikTok.

notes.title: Cargo Line Vol.4: Military - Out Now!
notes.content:
Cargo Line Volume 4: Military

In Volume 4, take charge of more secretive movements across the UK rail network; the transportation of military vehicles secured aboard KWA Warwell wagons.

The Rolling Stock
KWA Warwell Wagons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/24246a17e83e8887cd19a4fcc072dbef98d4f689.jpg

The KWA Warwell wagon was introduced to the UK amidst the Second World War. These wagons feature a low profile for being laden with large equipment while keeping within Britain’s restrictive loading gauge.

The days of mass-importing Sherman tanks from across the pond have long since passed, but the railways still provide a vital role in modern national security. Rail-served Ministry of Defence sites are still dotted about the country to this day, and many pieces of equipment are still transported between them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7a1669159002cf46a4aba650a6bbcd455c5c5e62.jpg

This brand-new wagon to Train Sim World is in a heavily weathered military green livery. The wagon consists of a main deck featuring a lower central portion and mounted on two wheeled bogies. Conventional draw gear and buffers are located at each end.

The wagon is available in three conditions:

 Unloaded/empty
 Loaded with a generic tracked armed personnel carrier (APC)
 Loaded with a 3-axle Mine Resistant Ambush Protected vehicle (MRAP).


The loads included are interpretations of real-world vehicles that do not feature guns or munitions. Skyhook Games made a statement concerning this on the Dovetail Games Forums.

The pack also comes with the DB Cargo variant of the Class 66, previously seen in other Train Sim World Add-ons.

Timetable, Scenarios and Gameplay
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/cc0258ab35afb419d4becb8d01b9eb236289d5fa.jpg

Gameplay takes place across two routes:

 Great Western Express
 West Coast Main Line: Preston-Carlisle
 These are available as separate route Add-ons.


Great Western Express
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/47a07a976d2d1cb0df5c794dff9a828f32eb1322.jpg

Gameplay on GWE represents military movements between bases in the Westcountry, Oxfordshire and Essex making use of the various yards on the route such as Southall and Acton.

There are 3 Scenarios for Great Western Express and 6 timetabled services to operate between London and Reading.

West Coast Main Line: Preston - Carlisle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c3d131478ba1f5753d6922da43b993cd0ad000f9.jpg

On Just Trains’ West Coast Main Line: Preston – Carlisle route, gameplay represents movements that would have taken place in the late 1980s moving equipment to the coast or through the country to other military bases located off the map in Scotland or the Midlands.

These trains are hauled by the Class 47 included in the route Add-on, rather than the Class 66.

There are 3 Scenarios for WCML Preston-Carlisle and 8 timetabled services to operate between Preston and Carlisle.

Journey Mode is also supported in ‘Armoured Personnel Carrier’

There will also undoubtedly be other routes to explore use of military freight on in Free Roam... heritage railways often host themed events, with the West Somerset Railway occasionally chartering military freight trains for special events in September.

8th Generation Console Experience
Please note that for PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, the spread of other trains running around has been reduced to provide acceptable performance. This reduction does not apply to PC, Xbox S/X or PlayStation 5 versions.

Train Sim World 5: Cargo Line Vol.4: Military is out now for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for £9.99/€11.99/$14.99

*UK pricing is £9.49 on the PlayStation Store

Find out more about Train Sim World 5 by following @trainsimworld on X/Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Twitch and TikTok.

notes.title: Train Sim World 5 Game Update - June 2nd
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Our next patch is live and brings a bunch of improvements across the board. Or should I say… all aboard? We’ve made some core fixes to help things run more smoothly, including some minor memory improvements for better stability during scenarios. In guard mode, ticket details should now show the right info. We’ve also fixed a few UI/menu/HUD issues. 

We’ve made improvements to add-ons, both older and newer, including our newly released Frankfurt S-Bahn, which has had its 2D map crashing issue resolved. Check out the highlights and the full changelog below!

As always, please allow up to 24 hours for it to fully reach your system. Be aware that some systems may update automatically.

Highlights
Core
-    Added minor memory improvements during scenarios for more stability.
-    Fixed an issue causing the ‘T’ shortcut timetable menu to always show ‘on foot’ when in a timetable service.
- Fixed an issue causing the ‘create new profile’ button to be inaccessible.
- Fixed an issue in Guard Mode which caused ticket details to show the wrong date or destination.

Frankfurt S-Bahn
- Fixed an issue causing the game to crash when opening the 2D map.
- Fixed an issue at Mainz Hbf causing the camera to jump into the above building near the overpass.

West Coast Mainline South
Class 350
- Updated traction brake so that emergency brakes now apply correctly when the reverser is off or neutral.
Class 66
- Fixed an issue with the datacord keypad not reading the #4 key.

Full Changelog
Core
- Added minor memory improvements during scenarios for more stability.
- Fixed a UI issue on consoles that was causing the pause menu to misalign.
- Fixed an issue causing the ‘create new profile’ button to be inaccessible.
- Fixed an issue that was causing the HUD to appear in normal mode even though it would be set to minimal.
- Fixed an issue causing the ‘T’ shortcut timetable menu to always show ‘on foot’ when in a timetable service.
- Fixed an issue in Guard Mode which caused ticket details to show the wrong date or destination.
- Various localisation improvements.

Frankfurt S-Bahn
- Changed the display boards to single displays to fix the blank slot at Mainz Hbf.
- Fixed an issue causing the game to crash when opening the 2D map.
- Fixed an issue at Mainz Hbf causing the camera to jump into the above building near the overpass.
- Fixed a lighting issue around the tunnel east of Flughafen Fernverkehr.
- Removed a floating OLHE in Floersheim.
DB BR 423
- Added ‘brake key on’ sound cue.

Thomas & Friends™ 80th Anniversary Expansion
- Fixed an issue where Annie’s doors wouldn’t open during the Bishops Lydeard to Minehead service.
- Politely told Mr. Peters that he’s not supposed to be there for the final cinematic, so he no longer appears during it.

Thomas & Friends™ Visit the West Somerset Railway
- Fixed an issue causing the speedometer to stay visible when in photo mode.
- Fixed an issue causing the theme music to play at the wrong time when backing out from the Thomas menu.
- Fixed a ‘troublesome’ issue during the Diesel introduction which was causing the tooltip pop up to be massive. Astronauts should no longer be able to view it from space.
- Fixed an issue causing Diesel to go missing in the ‘Diesel’s Dilemma’ scenario on Xbox. We do actually need you there for that Diesel.
- Various localisation changes.
- Various minor HUD improvements.

West Coast Mainline South
Class 350
- Updated traction brake so that emergency brakes now apply correctly when the reverser is off or neutral.
Class 390 Pendolino
- Fixed GSM-R duplicate ‘6’ decal error.
- Fixed inconsistent ‘8’ button appearance.
Class 66
- Fixed an issue with the datacord keypad not reading the #4 key.

Zwolle – Groningen

- Fixed an issue causing speed restrictions to not be displayed between Europapark and Onnen.
- Fixed an issue causing rain sounds to play while in a loco under any canopy at Zwolle.
- Added a missing station canopy and bridges at Zwolle station.

Cardiff City Commuter
- Added the ‘yes’ and ‘no’ text which had been missing from the fast travel pop up.
- Fixed an issue causing markers to remain on NPCs during ‘load passengers’ objectives.

Frankfurt Fulda
Flixtrain Vectron
- Fixed an issue causing Vectron door controls to stop working with IC coaches in free roam.

Bremen – Oldenburg
Vectron
- Fixed an issue causing Vectron door controls to stop working with IC coaches in free roam.

Mannheim Kaiserlautern
- Fixed an issue with missing start markers in the Scenario Planner 2D map.

HKA Wagon Pack
- Fixed an issue with the livery editor not working.

MBTA Commuter

- Fixed an issue where the horn or horn sequencer would incorrectly trigger the bell.

San Bernardino

notes.title: Frankfurt S-Bahn: Out Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5Zu3yTAvQbE;full][/previewyoutube]

Frankfurt S-Bahn: S1, S8 & S9

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ff10bf64dbaa0e33fdd26be63ebf2cdd18c8f087.jpg

Frankfurt S-Bahn cover three distinct lines as part of Frankfurt’s S-Bahn network and introduces the DB BR 430 for the first time. Additional rolling stock and plentiful layers from previous Train Sim World Add-ons also feature, making for a sprawling route with many stations and lots of traffic.

The Route

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/cc82031f169bdfee2c9542c7eb5dce3e1c482bc4.jpg

As the title of the Add-on suggests, there are three lines that form part of this route.

These are:
 S1: Frankfurt to Wiesbaden via Frankfurt Höscht
 S8: Frankfurt to Wiesbaden via Flughafen & Mainz Hbf
 S9: Frankfurt to Wiesbaden Flughafen & Mainz-Kastel

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7b7c5f5a60ba24c5892124feae632108bbd21777.jpg

The route is set prior to the opening of Frankfurt Gateway Gardens, offering the chance to traverse over the original airport approach which no longer exists.

ICE services running across the route from Frankfurt to Wiesbaden via Flughafen Fernbahnhof will be available for players with Train Sim World 5’s core Frankfurt – Fulda route. Flughafen Fernbahnhof mostly serves long-distance trains, which is uncommon in Germany. It has an average of one ICE every 9 minutes during peak times - equating to around 160 ICE stops every day.

The addition of the long-distance airport station to the route was done so following player feedback.
Additionally, to support this, the freight loop in Mainz will now also be in the route, enabling trains to enter Mainz from the north after coming from Frankfurt.

The Trains
DB BR 430 [NEW]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/25a6d72874a3bc67085d02cb262d7a323a6d9284.jpg

New to Frankfurt S-Bahn is the hard-working DB BR 430 EMU, which operates the bulk of traffic on the S1, S8 and S9 lines. This 4-car, high-capacity EMU has been in full operation on the S-Bahn Rhein-Main since their introduction a little over a decade ago.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/3cb5b3913c63ed9b76d6ae9cecc010010a213359.jpg

The design is reminiscent of the DB BR 422, although with more modern fittings and tweaks befitting of a busy network such as Frankfurt. The 430s replaced the much-lamented DB BR 420 and expanded the size of the fleet to offer a total of 9 trains an hour in each direction, spread across all 3 lines, with up to 12-car formations.

Audio was sourced courtesy of a recording trip and the interior is fitted with modern PIS in the passenger area and digital screens in the cab.

DB BR 423

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c1b74886c7ecae7c234b81acecd8966586c2ccb3.jpg

Supplementing the BR 430 is the DB BR 423, a staple EMU for S-Bahn networks across Germany.

The version included with Frankfurt S-Bahn will feature a new interior to represent the S-Bahn Rhein-Main variant, as well as some physics upgrades. The BR 423 fleet is certainly no stranger to the Wiesbaden lines, although spends a majority of its time serving other destinations, making it a key part of the scene around Frankfurt Hbf.

DB BR 143 + Dostos

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/81ef49079e221b119d1e409dd9b256773d8ebd78.jpg

Providing a regional touch is the DB BR 143 and Dosto combination, which runs RB services out of Wiesbaden.

Additional Service layers

Bundle available on Steam

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ad948ac2a24726cafa6a1991bb7b6513fd46b273.jpg

The action takes place over a full 24-hour timetable, with services running throughout and providing gameplay at all times of day. The new DB BR 430 will operate on the many hundreds of services that keep the commuters of Hesse on the move.

The addition of the Frankfurt Airport long-distance station opens up new types of gameplay for players with additional content in their collection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/33cff3700828202e86708ff738d6630b529a2ce4.jpg

AI-only traffic such as ICE and freight will also suitably layer in across the route, with freight operating both locally and end-to-end. RE and RB traffic also features as AI, utilising the timetable from Frankfurt – Fulda and trains from other route Add-ons such as Maintalbahn for the DB BR 642.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/d5c8b6e43d97691acbef71a037c8471a45355ef3.jpg

The full list of Add-ons that layer services into Frankfurt S-Bahn is as follows:

Playable and AI services:
 Kassel-Würzburg
 Frankfurt-Fulda
 DB BR 101 loco Add-on
 Bremen-Oldenburg
 Maintalbahn
 Ruhr Sieg Nord and DB BR 363 loco Add-on

The BR 628 from Niddertalbahn will also feature as AI traffic.

Freight services utilising Frankfurt-Fulda's DB BR 193 Vectron will haul stock layered from S-Bahn Vorarlberg (Laaers), Dresden-Riesa (Zacns), Kassel-Würzburg (VTG Eanos) as well as Sggmrss and Habbiins wagons.

For players that own all the relevant content, the full timetable provides the busiest experience ever seen in a German route Add-on, with approximately 1,000 services included.
Frankfurt S-Bahn Layers Bundle

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/abdf8562845dde1f26ae49493d5cfa75f935622c.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53103/Train_Sim_World_5_Frankfurt_SBahn_Complete_Layering_Bundle/

You can save on a selection of these layers in the Frankfurt S-Bahn Layer Bundle available on Steam from launch at approximately 1800 BST on Tuesday 20th May. This bundle does not include Frankfurt S-Bahn itself.

Timetable variants across platforms

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/69c70f5d96da7190148cb3ca9e09ad4f9758d35f.jpg

In order to provide a suitable experience across all platforms, two variants of the Frankfurt S-Bahn timetable have been developed, a Standard and a Full version.

The following platforms will see different options available to choose from:

PS5 and Xbox Series S/X
 Standard timetable
Steam and Epic Games
 Full timetable with all additional layers

The standard timetable features just over 600 playable services in total. These are formed from the three included trains (430, 423 and 143 + Dostos) and playable service layers for the DB BR 411 ICE-T for those with Frankfurt-Fulda.

The standard timetable will also be available to Steam and Epic players in addition to the full timetable.

Further down the Tracks: DB BR 420

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/41dabc50f02e6ad41acc29eb5c0ed6586924b63c.jpg

In the March 2025 Roadmap, we re-announced the upcoming DB BR 420 Loco from the TSG team, helping support gameplay on the upcoming Frankfurt S-Bahn route.

You can read some more details in the April 2025 Roadmap. We’ll be sure to check back with the TSG team in a later Roadmap to provide an update on progress.

Note: when complete, the DB BR 420 loco Add-on will also release on PC and Gen 9 console platforms only (Xbox Series S|X & PS5).

Additional Gameplay

With Free Roam, players can explore the multiple paths along each line in their favourite traction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/0872256161f32e2d1c2755d8a3ee5a30f16dd100.jpg

There’ll also be Route Hopping with Frankfurt – Fulda (at Frankfurt am Main Hbf) and with Linke Rheinstrecke at (Mainz Hbf). For players with these routes and Schnellfahrstrecke Kassel-Würzburg, a monumental 320km journey awaits between Koblenz and Kassel with three hopping points across four route Add-ons!

Mastery Challenges:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c412b69dcd88d9de296fe6ea6edb19acbee82c1a.jpg

Mastery on Frankfurt S-Bahn unlocks the new in-game Posters for the route that we introduced to selected Train Sim World 5 route Add-ons (Tier 1) and a Scenery Tile at Wiesbaden.

The Scenery Tile represents the popular Festivals that take place, with music included during both day and nighttime for those who choose the toggle the Scenery Tile on.

Complete timetable services and Scenarios or drive a pre-set number of kilometers to unlock them!

Preview Livestream in English and German

[previewyoutube=N_aEyyYdC0c;full][/previewyoutube]

Rewatch the preview streams on Railfan TV and TrainSimPlay over on YouTube and Twitch

[previewyoutube=XdGh9RmYPfA;full][/previewyoutube]

Train Sim World 5: Frankfurt S-Bahn: S1, S8 & S9 is out now for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for €35.99/£29.99/$39.99

notes.title: Class 86/2 Loco Add-on: Coming Soon!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c6a36933beb14b126e3136d341a302aed3894b94.jpg

Tap into classic British AC traction with BR Class 86/2 services on the West Coast Main Line. Just Trains’ latest Add-on is coming soon!

The Story So Far:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/a38b72b77e5c58f0734b898dac5b108b85706a5b.jpg

We've already talked a little bit about Just Trains’ first Train Sim World loco Add-on as have they in their Development Blog entries.

This includes:

 Reveal in Week 1 of our 2024 Season of Reveals
 An update on developing the locomotive in the January 2025 Roadmap
 An update on the coaches included in the February 2025 Roadmap
 A look at the coach interiors in the March 2025 Roadmap


Rolling Stock
BR Class 86/2
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/4622673714d0a6334fb3d15c3f178528011ddb1b.jpg

The Class 86 brings additional challenges to the stunning WCML: Preston - Carlisle route, as well as all-new variety in the form of British Rail’s Mk2F coaches.

The Class 86 entered service in the mid-1960s after years of testing different designs to run on the newly electrified West Coast Main Line. Known originally as the AL6, it would become the first mass-produced AC loco for the new fleet with 100 examples built.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/30c2999ecbdd39822a26ac4a6f9c7665007cb888.jpg

Over time, a revision to the suspension was undertaken to solve issues of rough riding and track wear, these changes resulted in what became known as the Class 86/2 subclass. Being the precursor to the Class 87, the Class 86/2, with less horsepower, was capable of 100mph which makes for a more challenging driving experience. Other differences from the 87 include the plated over headcode box, and the distinctive triple windscreen.

In more recent years, both the Class 87 and Class 86 have seen some international service in Europe, predominantly in Bulgaria, where some are still used on freight trains under various operators.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/0424c7b42fb135ab55f96b95088b9fa087f7b07c.jpg

Operating the Class 86 in-game will be a challenge for new and existing players on WCML Preston – Carlisle. The locomotive works in a similar way to the Class 87, with tap changer controls that require a degree of planning to manage speed limits, stops and gradients.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/1e3e7921a5232e52615ef767e4fb7409d34b3b5b.jpg

Unlike the Class 87 however, the Class 86 has less power. As a result, poor timing with the power before the climb up to Shap can result in time lost, as the train builds speed slower than expected.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/72840b8cfca89800c66c70b879c2133dfe2da118.jpg

The Class 86 has a fully accessible engine room (this is where the DSD isolation is located) and a detailed, weathered cab. It also comes in two liveries: BR Blue and Intercity Executive with specific details implemented on individual locomotives, such as those on ‘City of Coventry’ detailed in the March Roadmap.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ed55b4a5d24499e850fa4e04b3ea84f774629875.jpg

Included are several external variations of the 86/2 which feature changes such two different types of Pantographs, RCH cables, a centrally mounted High Intensity head light and a single Rally light uniquely fitted to 86225. The eagle-eyed amongst you will remember this light from the first ever teaser image for the 86/2.

Amongst the numerous liveries included is Locomotive number 86233, named Laurence Olivier, is unique in the 86 fleet for having a white cab roof at both ends during the mid-1980’s. This distinctive marking was applied to commemorate the 21st Anniversary of the creation of Inter-City.

Mk2F Coaches & Mk1 RMB
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/65d635f102d750228fa5d541e28a7de99aacc40b.jpg

Also included in the pack are Mk2F Coaches, in BSO, TSO and FO variants.

The air-conditioned Mk2s were the mainstay of many long-distance passenger trains after their introduction in the 1970s, and have seen use ever since, in both service, engineering and railtour duties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/fcdf135a550492757b5ae3ab650e4f3f2dae218a.jpg

The feature coach of the Class 86/2 is the much-requested BR Mk1 RMB Buffet Car.

RMB standing for Restaurant Miniature Buffet. The RMB is basically a British Railways Mk1 TSO (Tourist Standard Open) coach where the centre vestibule seating area has been replaced with a buffet counter a small seating area along with standing space and store cupboard. Either side of this is the normal full seating areas. The RMB’s were built between 1957 and 1962. There are still quite a few in service on heritage railways across the UK.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/187642a44fc59bf667a6e0414312c6cc0ef240f0.jpg

The RMB features the InterCity Executive and BR Blue Grey liveries.

When you enter the RMB, make your way to the Buffet area where behind the operating roller shutter you will see a fully stocked area with a great variety of top-quality (curly) sandwiches, fresh (yesterday) Pork Pies (in two sizes), bags of crisps, bottles of soft drinks with flavours such as Apple, Orange, and Berry!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7b87c502ebc0fb96b85b8d8e4a47e8478df8a464.jpg

Timetable services and additional gameplay
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/38efe9e41d4ae9b8cacdd1173d8aa60036f26e9c.jpg

Both the Class 86 and Mk2 Coaches will substitute into the current WCML: Preston – Carlisle timetable in place of some Class 87-hauled services.

The timetable for WCML: Preston – Carlisle has Class 87 services running cross-country trains across the route. These services will be substituted by Class 86 locomotives as would have been the case during the period.

As the Class 86/2 was not a common feature on freight services, these will all continue to be Class 87 hauled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/9241727d43f89a652277cf35babf5941a61cebd4.jpg

5 new Scenarios will also be available to play on the route, ranging from a football Special out of the map to Wembley to represent England playing against Scotland during April 1986.

Others including a delayed service requires some rerouting and the southbound express bound for London requires some assistance... can you take on the challenge?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/735c9e916a48632093e7923e3e8a85e05ca2e9a4.jpg

Players keen on making use of the Mk1 RMB will be able to do so in Formation Designer, along with the Mk2F Coaches and the Class 86 with these coaches can be spawned in Free Roam.

Train Sim World 5: Class 86/2 & Mk2F Coaches is releasing soon for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for £19.99 / €24.99 / $24.99

You can learn more in Just Trains' Development Blog entries.

Just Trains’ latest route for Train Sim World is the longest UK route ever developed! Thrash both the electric Class 87 and diesel Class 47 up Shap Summit across almost 100 miles of northwest tracks between Preston and Carlisle.

Class 101 DMU and Class 08 shunting services are also included, with layered services and AI featuring for players with Just Trains’ other route Add-on: Blackpool Branches and other Train Sim World Add-ons like Flying Scotsman and Northern Trans-Pennine.

Steam players can get a 10% discount on WCML Preston - Carlisle in the final day of the May Madness Sale!

Xbox players with Game Pass Ultimate can also get 10% off selected Add-ons.

Additional Class 87 liveries
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/0b4d7a77ed1788c8cf84d5ec50169c5560d9bef4.jpg

Players with WCML: Preston – Carlisle also received some additional liveries as part of a recent patch update. You can read the full details for this route and others in the Patch Notes.

The additional liveries include two variations of the existing intercity executive, one with red buffers and one which is heavily weathered as well as another two variations with an extended yellow panel at the front with black and red buffers and finally one variation with a full yellow front with black numbers and decals.

The Class 86 loco Add-on is not required in order to receive these additional Class 87 liveries.

notes.title: Train Sim World 5 Game Update - May 12th
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/db6440e3204072a542875ef8bfe240fd232bad8d.jpg

Our next patch is now live and packed with improvements across multiple routes and locos, both from ourselves and our development partners. Midland Main Line has received some visual fixes and improvements, while the Class 87 on WCML Person – Carlisle now has five new livery variants (photos of which are at the bottom of the full changelog) along with a bunch of other fixes! The ICMm Koploper from Zwolle – Groningen and the Class 150 from Cardiff Commuter have both received some audio improvements, too!

Take a look at some of the highlights, and if you’re in a reading mood the full changelog, below!
As always, please allow up to 24 hours for it to fully reach your system. Be aware that some systems may update automatically.

Highlights
Midland Main Line
• Added TSW5 track shadow improvements
• Added steam emission back to Ratcliffe power station
• Added Aircraft Obstruction lights to the thin chimney at Ratcliffe Power Station
• Added ‘Stay Calm’ posters at Leicester, Derby and Nottingham stations
• Implementing new water materials
• Improved static stock at Beeston yard
Class 158
• Added TSW5 Guard Mode
• Added Dynamic gangways
• Improved interior lighting
Class 43 HST EMT
• Improved material when wet to be consistent with the Mk3 coaches.
• Improved support for Free Roam consist placement and Formation Designer.

WCML Preston-Carlisle
Class 87
• Added 5 new livery variations for the Class 87
o Intercity full yellow front.
o Intercity full yellow front with red bufferbeam.
o Heavily weathered Intercity half yellow front.
o Intercity half yellow front red bufferbeam.
o Intercity full yellow front wrapped around cab with black numbers and decals.​
• Updated formation and destination of 1V81 to match naming.
• Added a new front loader vehicle asset to the route in the three quarries: Shap Beck, Hardendale and Shap Summit.

Zwolle-Groningen
• Improved draw distance of distant factory scenery models.
ICMm Koploper
• Wide range of audio improvements to vastly improve sounds and reported issues.
o Added sun visor open/close sounds
o Added a rattle that appears around 20kph & 70kph to mimic cab resonating from the traction motors
o Added new deadman pedal sounds for the activated & deactivated states
o Implemented new internal chopper sounds

New York-Trenton
• Fixed an issue where AI train alerters are all going off incorrectly.

Full Changelog
Core
• Fixed an issue for the Training Center BR 146.2, where the front wheels and axles were clipping incorrectly on tight curves.

Midland Main Line
• Added Aircraft Obstruction lights to the thin chimney at Ratcliffe Power Station.
• Added Stay Calm campaign posters at Leicester, Derby and Nottingham stations.
• Added steam emission back to Ratcliffe power station.
• Improved static stock at Beeston yard.
• Improved draw distance of multiple scenery elements.
• Changed Intermodal services to be player drivable with Cargo Line Vol.3 Intermodal.

• Fixed arch bridge LOD causing bad shadow and visual spikes at distance.
• Fixed distant visuals of signal gantries so they don't turn white.
• Fixed floating bench at Syston station.
• Implemented TSW5 track shadow tech.
• Implemented water material tech.
• Fixed some blurred textures appearing on trains when near Hempstead heath station.
Class 43 HST
• Improved material when wet to be consistent with the Mk3 coaches.
• Improved support for Free Roam consist placement and Formation Designer.

Class 158

• Added dynamic gangways.
• Fixed cab gangways preventing passage when in motion.
• Fixed camera height of Secondman seat.
• Fixed half the lights in the passenger saloon not being illuminated.
• Fixed interior lights LODing out after a short distance.
• Improved interior lighting learnt from ScotRail Class 158.
• Improved support for Free Roam consist placement and Formation Designer.

• Fixed numerous services in the timetable.

o Added sun visor open/close sounds.

o Added new deadman pedal sounds for the activated & deactivated states
o Implemented new internal chopper sounds.

o Updated the DVD component to trigger new relay & air sounds when the visual warning is displayed and once acknowledged.
o When moving the control handle into driving, parking or cleaning should turn on the cab idle buzz.
o Removed a “click” sound from the external running audio.​
• Fixed tail lights to be controlled much like the headlights, where the switches only operate the tail lights for their corresponding side.
• Fixed an issue where PIS displays "Rotterdam Centraal" inaccurately.

Cardiff City Commuter
Class 150
• Reverser is now capable of 360 degree rotation
Class 153
• Fixed some circumstances which prevented sitting in the driver's seat.

Linke Rheinstrecke: Mainz – Koblenz
The following changes were made by the TSG team to support the upcoming BR194 and E94 Railtour Pack.
• Added missing junction motors in the Mainz region.
• Added missing distant signal in Uhlerborn.
• Added missing speed sign to 110kmh and PZB magnets at Boppard.
• Updated the water around the Rhine River.
• Fixed a rough embankment area on the approach to Mainz.
• Fixed an overgrown area of tall grass at Ingelheim.
• Fixed an issue with the level crossing North of St Goar.
• Fixed the crossing after Werlau, between Ingelheim and Gau Algesheim.

• Various localisation improvements.

Thomas & Friends™ Visit West Somerset Railway

Mittenwaldbahn
ÖBB 1020
• Added Key binding for Schnell Aus (Tap changer down, or Ctrl + D).
• Fixed Indusi Frei button to work as expected.
• Fixed motor attenuation so it doesn't instantly cut out past a certain distance.
• Fixed motor excitation being taken off motor 6 instead of motor 1.
n-Wagens
• Updated gangways to function better and work properly with the Umbauwagens.
• Fixed Diameter of Brake Pipes which were previously too small.

ECML Diesel Railtour Pack
• Added interactable vestibule doors to Mk1 BSO and TSO variants with new animations.
• Updated Mk1 coach interior lighting across all variants, which now can be turned on/off.

• Updated Mk1 Coach cabling to be more accurate.

• Updated Mk1 FK window animation to appear correct and move window handle with the pane at the same time.
• Fixed an issue to ensure DSD Stop and DSD Tone audio play as expected.

• Fixed an issue where furniture on MK1 BOS/TSO coaches was too shiny.

New York-Trenton
• Fixed an issue where AI train alerters are all going off incorrectly.

Cajon Pass
BNSF ESS4C4
• Fixed an issue where the player was not getting rewards for driving with safety systems enabled.

Schnellfahrstrecke Kassel-Würzburg
• Changed safety system events for gamepad to not acknowledge PZB when not needed.

Frankfurt Fulda
• Refreshed RVD asset size data for rolling stock compatible with Frankfurt Fulda.
• Fixed an issue causing players to fall through the map at Bad Soden.

Vectron
• Fixed an issue with the 500Hz indicator light not showing on the MFD screen.
DB BR 146
• Updated the suspension so the front wheels no longer clip into the axles on tight curves.

Mannheim – Kaiserslautern
• Fixed an issue where some stations were missing their start markers in the Scenario Planner 2D map.

MBTA Commuter
HSP 46
• Fixed an issue where the bell activated when using the horn or horn sequencer.

WCML South HKA Wagon Add-on
• Fixed an issue preventing livery editor from functioning.

notes.title: Thomas & Friends™ 80th Anniversary Expansion - Coming Soon
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b17cd8f67990d4fb81d0300140ee68594e776f2b.jpg

Continue the story of Thomas’ visit to the West Somerset Railway with the Thomas & Friends™ 80th Anniversary Expansion coming soon to Train Sim World 5!

Celebrate with a new story:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/4940a8ca79371a8c0bf8bf20d49221245788b391.jpg

Sir Topham Hatt and Diesel are preparing to throw a surprise birthday celebration for Thomas, who has been given a special coat of paint!
Following the events of Thomas’ first full day on the West Somerset Railway (played out in the previous Add-on), preparations are underway to celebrate Thomas’ birthday. He’s very excited for his birthday and is looking forward to the big celebration!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/8089e313876a73a49383d4f1dc46c37ead87d5ce.jpg

Sir Topham Hatt has a very important job for Diesel, who has been trying to be on his best behaviour and is eager to please. Work with Diesel as he goes to collect The Troublesome Trucks filled with party supplies, but will they get up to their usual tricks?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/16b585bf025152461492b18b9441e2dab46728c4.jpg

Be a really useful engine as you take passengers on Annie & Clarabel and help out when others are in need.

Thomas the Tank Engine
Original Green Livery

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/9d9cb64a0835ed247109b2dcd676a48f22615303.jpg

As a special gift, Thomas has asked to be repainted for his birthday! Travel with Thomas around the West Somerset Railway in his Original Green Livery, complete with his original number 70 and white pinstripe lining.

Thomas hasn’t been painted in these colours in a very long time and looks just like he did when he first arrived on Sodor! It only seems right that he should wear his original colours for the special day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ccb4e7e3b39423781a6e7bb64f2acac0c885a481.jpg

As was the case before his repaint, driving with Thomas has been set up to be as intuitive and accessible as possible for everyone to enjoy. Throttle and brake controls are simplified.

The adventure continues:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/68a53491b46c43033d31966f5635b0f6129cc508.jpg

The 80th Anniversary Expansion continues the visit of Thomas and his friends to the West Somerset Railway with an additional 3-part narrated story.
You can also use Free Roam to take Thomas in his original colours on a tour of the mainland, or even visit his original hometown of Brighton for those with the East Coastway and London - Brighton route Add-ons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/dc75291bf8547a1bdd6e1d47f97d2646ca1abe0c.jpg

Train Sim World 5

Train Sim World 5: Thomas & Friends™ Edition is out now for Steam for $39.99/£29.99/€34.99

notes.title: Frankfurt S-Bahn: Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GrnMgepHAoM;full][/previewyoutube]

The Story So Far:

We added this next German route Add-on to our February 2025 Roadmap. We later confirmed the route and the extent of the lines covered.

This included:
 Reveal in the March 2025 Roadmap
 A tongue-in-cheek reveal of Frankfurt Flughafen Fernbahnhof for April Fools Day
 Further information about the route in the April 2025 Roadmap

Frankfurt S-Bahn: S1, S8 & S9

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ff10bf64dbaa0e33fdd26be63ebf2cdd18c8f087.jpg

Frankfurt S-Bahn cover three distinct lines as part of Frankfurt’s S-Bahn network and introduces the DB BR 430 for the first time. Additional rolling stock and plentiful layers from previous Train Sim World Add-ons also feature, making for a sprawling route with many stations and lots of traffic.

The Route

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/cc82031f169bdfee2c9542c7eb5dce3e1c482bc4.jpg

The S-Bahn Rhein-Main came about in the late 1970s, when various routes out of Frankfurt were brought together as a single network. Also built and added onto the network was a connection to Frankfurt Airport, both the S-Bahn itself in 1980, and long-distance trains in 1999. Both feature in the in-game route.

Over time, many additions and modifications have been made to the network to match increasing demand. In 2018, multiple lines introduced nightly operations, offering 24/7 service in and out of bustling Frankfurt.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7b7c5f5a60ba24c5892124feae632108bbd21777.jpg

As the title of the Add-on suggests, there are three lines that form part of this route.

These are:
 S1: Frankfurt to Wiesbaden via Frankfurt Höscht
 S8: Frankfurt to Wiesbaden via Flughafen & Mainz Hbf
 S9: Frankfurt to Wiesbaden Flughafen & Mainz-Kastel

The route is set prior to the opening of Frankfurt Gateway Gardens, offering the chance to traverse over the original airport approach which no longer exists.

ICE services running across the route from Frankfurt to Wiesbaden via Flughafen Fernbahnhof will be available for players with Train Sim World 5’s core Frankfurt – Fulda route. Flughafen Fernbahnhof mostly serves long-distance trains, which is uncommon in Germany. It has an average of one ICE every 9 minutes during peak times - equating to around 160 ICE stops every day.

The addition of the long-distance airport station to the route was done so following player feedback.

Additionally, to support this, the freight loop in Mainz will now also be in the route, enabling trains to enter Mainz from the north after coming from Frankfurt.

The Trains

DB BR 430 [NEW]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/25a6d72874a3bc67085d02cb262d7a323a6d9284.jpg

New to Frankfurt S-Bahn is the hard-working DB BR 430 EMU, which operates the bulk of traffic on the S1, S8 and S9 lines. This 4-car, high-capacity EMU has been in full operation on the S-Bahn Rhein-Main since their introduction a little over a decade ago.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/3cb5b3913c63ed9b76d6ae9cecc010010a213359.jpg

The design is reminiscent of the DB BR 422, although with more modern fittings and tweaks befitting of a busy network such as Frankfurt. The 430s replaced the much-lamented DB BR 420 and expanded the size of the fleet to offer a total of 9 trains an hour in each direction, spread across all 3 lines, with up to 12-car formations.



DB BR 423

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c1b74886c7ecae7c234b81acecd8966586c2ccb3.jpg

Supplementing the BR 430 is the DB BR 423, a staple EMU for S-Bahn networks across Germany.

The version included with Frankfurt S-Bahn will feature a new interior to represent the S-Bahn Rhein-Main variant, as well as some physics upgrades. The BR 423 fleet is certainly no stranger to the Wiesbaden lines, although spends a majority of its time serving other destinations, making it a key part of the scene around Frankfurt Hbf.

DB BR 143 + Dostos

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/81ef49079e221b119d1e409dd9b256773d8ebd78.jpg

Providing a regional touch is the DB BR 143 and Dosto combination, which runs RB services out of Wiesbaden.

Timetable, Scenarios and Gameplay
Timetable and Additional Service layers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ad948ac2a24726cafa6a1991bb7b6513fd46b273.jpg

Many of the S-Bahn services will depart westbound from Frankfurt Hbf, including from its subterranean platforms, and embark on a multitude of journeys. Be it day or night, drive S1 services along the north face of the Main river or take the S8 and S9 via the airport on criss-crossing paths along the Rhine, and converge under the historic roof of Wiesbaden Hbf.

S1 services take a more direct westerly route out of Frankfurt, calling at suburban locations in the outskirts of the city and running north of the Main river, the longest tributary of the Rhine, all the way to Wiesbaden.

S8 and S9 services share an alternative path which initially heads south to serve Frankfurt Airport’s Regional station, before stopping at all stations on the Mainbahn, south of the Main.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/6371a6211e718080fea11ba02079e1ba9ad85947.jpg

The action takes place over a full 24-hour timetable, with services running throughout and providing gameplay at all times of day. The new DB BR 430 will operate on the many hundreds of services that keep the commuters of Hesse on the move.

The addition of the Frankfurt Airport long-distance station opens up new types of gameplay for players with additional content in their collection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/34528fd049f3a55f351eca55f3688d34fdb29836.jpg

On that line, players can operate:
 ICE3 services with Kassel-Würzburg
 ICE1 services between Frankfurt and Mainz with Kassel-Würzburg
 ICE-T services from Frankfurt Hbf to Wiesbaden via the Airport and Mainz with Frankfurt-Fulda
 IC services with the DB BR 101 loco Add-on

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/33cff3700828202e86708ff738d6630b529a2ce4.jpg

AI-only traffic such as ICE and freight will also suitably layer in across the route, with freight operating both locally and end-to-end. RE and RB traffic also features as AI, utilising the timetable from Frankfurt – Fulda and trains from other route Add-ons such as Maintalbahn for the DB BR 642.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/d5c8b6e43d97691acbef71a037c8471a45355ef3.jpg

The full list of Add-ons that layer services into Frankfurt S-Bahn is as follows:

Playable and AI services:
 Kassel-Würzburg
 Frankfurt-Fulda
 DB BR 101 loco Add-on
 Bremen-Oldenburg
 Maintalbahn
 Ruhr Sieg Nord and DB BR 363 loco Add-on

The BR 628 from Niddertalbahn will also feature as AI traffic.

Freight services utilising Frankfurt-Fulda's DB BR 193 Vectron will haul stock layered from S-Bahn Vorarlberg (Laaers), Dresden-Riesa (Zacns), Kassel-Würzburg (VTG Eanos) as well as Sggmrss and Habbiins wagons.

For players that own all the relevant content, the full timetable provides the busiest experience ever seen in a German route Add-on, with approximately 1,000 services included.

Timetable variants across platforms

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/69c70f5d96da7190148cb3ca9e09ad4f9758d35f.jpg

In order to provide a suitable experience across all platforms, two variants of the Frankfurt S-Bahn timetable have been developed, a Full and a Reduced version.

The following platforms will see different options available to choose from:

Steam and Epic Games - Full timetable and Reduced timetable

PS5 and Xbox Series S/X - Reduced timetable only

The reduced timetable features just over 600 playable services in total. These are formed from the three included trains (430, 423 and 143 + Dostos) and playable service layers for the DB BR 411 ICE-T for those with Frankfurt-Fulda.

The reduced timetable will also be available to Steam and Epic players in addition to the full timetable.

Further down the Tracks: DB BR 420

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/41dabc50f02e6ad41acc29eb5c0ed6586924b63c.jpg

In the March 2025 Roadmap, we re-announced the upcoming DB BR 420 Loco from the TSG team, helping support gameplay on the upcoming Frankfurt S-Bahn route.

You can read some more details in the April 2025 Roadmap. We’ll be sure to check back with the TSG team in a later Roadmap to provide an update on progress.
Note: when complete, the DB BR 420 loco Add-on will also release on PC and Gen 9 console platforms only (Xbox Series S|X & PS5).

Additional Gameplay

With Free Roam, players can explore the multiple paths along each line in their favourite traction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/0872256161f32e2d1c2755d8a3ee5a30f16dd100.jpg

There’ll also be Route Hopping with Frankfurt – Fulda (at Frankfurt am Main Hbf) and with Linke Rheinstrecke at (Mainz Hbf). For players with these routes and Schnellfahrstrecke Kassel-Würzburg, a monumental 320km journey awaits between Koblenz and Kassel with three hopping points across four route Add-ons!

Mastery Challenges:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c412b69dcd88d9de296fe6ea6edb19acbee82c1a.jpg

Mastery on Frankfurt S-Bahn unlocks the new in-game Posters for the route that we introduced to selected Train Sim World 5 route Add-ons (Tier 1) and a Scenery Tile at Wiesbaden.

The Scenery Tile represents the popular Festivals that take place, with music included during both day and nighttime for those who choose the toggle the Scenery Tile on.

Complete timetable services and Scenarios or drive a pre-set number of kilometers to unlock them!

Preview Livestream in English and German

[previewyoutube=N_aEyyYdC0c;full][/previewyoutube]

Catch the preview stream with Railfan TV over on YouTube and Twitch on Tuesday 13th May, with a German preview hosted by TrainSimPlay the following day on 14th May.

Train Sim World 5: Frankfurt S-Bahn: S1, S8 & S9 will release on 20th May for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for €35.99/£29.99/$39.99

notes.title: May Madness Sale On Steam!
notes.content:
6th - 13th May 2025 on the Steam Store
It's total MAY-hem on Steam, with a screen-full of blockbuster content on sale for Train Sim World.
Reels of railway content!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7b634a80a22f18cd565e89dbda10ac6405a0e146.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/a5220d5d27b9292f23b933f73aa0b3c6c2a62192.jpg

Whatever your preferred genre of railway content there are savings to be had including first-time discounts on new routes in Train Sim World 5.
Head back to the days of British Railway Romance with 50% off Peak Forest Railway. Take a steam-filled adventure with freight and passenger services from Ambergate through to Chinley or along the branch line to Buxton using a fleet of 4F, 8F and Jubilee locomotives.
Hit Hollywood and buzz of downtown LA with 50% off Antelope Valley Line, adding Route Hopping to Train Sim World 5's San Bernardino Line and big, bold American diesel power to your collection.
For a retro 1980s experience, Just Trains West Coast Main Line: Preston - Carlisle is 10% off ahead of their first loco Add-on release with the Class 86. There's something sci-fi about the deep hum of a British electric locomotive along the longest UK route ever to come to Train Sim World.
Get stuck into the grit of the Welsh urban nightlife with local branch line commuter services and ageing DMUs. Cardiff City Network is 20% off!
Embark on a special journey as Thomas the Tank Engine makes his debut in Train Sim World 5! Get a first-time discount on Steam with 20% off both the Thomas & Friends™ Visit the West Somerset Railway Add-on and Train Sim World 5: Thomas & Friends™ Edition.

Save 80% on TSW Compatible Content

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/462973561000419ff9c23468a7ca4dc76dd5224a.jpg

Last month Steam players with Köln - Aachen received the long-awaited timetable update bringing the total service count (with all content featured) up to around 4,000 services!
If you've yet to play this fan favourite and have some of the other Add-ons in your collection, you can now get 80% off this route Add-on.
There's also a Complete My Collection Köln - Aachen Timetable Bundle which allows you to add any outstanding content to either make use of separately or as part of the timetable update.
Prefer US or UK content? There's still a huge 80% off Sherman Hill and Birmingham Cross-City.

BR194 / E94 Content

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/f3b9d61a50e574b497ed87129f42bbd45a633394.jpg

If you follow the Train Sim World Roadmap, you'll know that TSG are working on their BR194 & E94 loco Add-on.
This Add-on will bring a new 1984 timetable to Linke Rheinstrecke (75% off), utilising layers from the DB BR 218 (10% off) and adds railtour services and Scenarios to Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn (20% off).

Cargo Line Collection

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7cad9c45574ff94f523a4ec0bcd3d610f5fc3bc8.jpg

Skyhook Games also recent released the third Add-on in their Cargo Line series. If you haven't yet enjoyed the additional gameplay from their previous Volumes, you can now get 50% off Volume 1: Petroleum, 30% off Volume 2: Aggregates and 50% off Midland Main Line, which hosts additional services.

Enjoy A Week of New Content!
All throughout the sales, you'll be able to catch your favourite Train Sim World creators play various add-ons and locos featured in our Steam sales! All of these will be live on the official Train Sim World streaming channels this week.
Check out our line-up below, and be sure to send some love to the creators featured!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/56ef98341c9476da601ba12f38920a0d4e7380e8.jpg

Thank you to The British Ace, TrainSimulatorDriver, CasualRail, Tygerways, Jimmy Dali, Richy Rail and Ramagani for sharing video content for you to enjoy!

notes.title: Train Sim World 5 Roadmap - May 2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/1723c95380e8a61ba847d3399c1224d93cf32137.jpg

TL;DR (too long; didn’t read) Summary
Content Up Ahead

 New Screenshots for Frankfurt S-bahn: S1, S8 & S9
