The Train Sim World Roadmap

New Screenshots for Frankfurt S-bahn: S1, S8 & S9

We're getting closer to the release of Frankfurt S-bahn, our next add-on to TSW, representing the S1, S8 and S9 lines of the S-Bahn Rhein-Main network, and covering over 80 km and a total of 26 stations between Frankfurt am Main Hbf, including the underground (tief) platforms, to Wiesbaden Hbf.

You'll be able to explore a huge range of gameplay, and the chance to traverse over the original airport approach which no longer exists. The S1 line will head directly west out of Frankfurt, calling at suburban locations in the outskirts of the city and running north of the Main river. S8 and S9 lines head south to serve Frankfurt Airport’s Regional station, before stopping at all stations on the Mainbahn, south of the Main. The Frankfurt Airport Long Distance station will also open up new types of gameplay, being able to drive ICE3, ICE1, ICE-T, IC and S-bahn services.

As a reminder for the rolling stock included:

 New DB BR 430, operating the bulk of traffic on the S1, S8 and S9 lines.
 Updated DB BR 423, with physics upgrades and a new interior to represent the S-Bahn Rhein-Main variant.
 Included DB BR 143 and Dosto combination, which runs RB services out of Wiesbaden

All other services which call at Fernbahnhof will be additional layers.

We'll be sharing a Frankfurt S-bahn's deep dive article very soon, where we'll cover all of the specific timetable layering details, but just as a teaser - get ready for a gameplay-packed experience, as the full timetable is coming in at 1000+ playable services included!

Whilst you wait, enjoy the latest selection of new Frankfurt S-bahn screenshots!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/69c70f5d96da7190148cb3ca9e09ad4f9758d35f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/bc9971fd9d31fa97746f1128ed26f6f502fcb984.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/a1335407a9962a3e65d81a8f8c57a7cd13311689.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c69ce69de7f4ef9e13c0612c9ce96ac6729e40ca.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/d5c8b6e43d97691acbef71a037c8471a45355ef3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/eab3a5bf8d40743248b92b3df5ad684e9a68eb29.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7e4babda78fe712750547921d3c9642bcb9cbe97.jpg

Third Party Partners
Cargo Line Volume. 4 – Military from Skyhook Games
Following the release of the Cargo Line Vol. 3 - Intermodal pack last week, Skyhook Games are getting ready to share their next volume: Cargo Line Vol.4 – Military!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ea0635439fdbba6bb8773096fdd1d0b3062cd09f.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/89f942b3e46344a7c6bfda5edddeca19face5c63.jpg

Get ready to try out a new KWA ‘Warwell’ wagon in heavily weathered military green livery, consisting of a main deck and featuring a lower central portion and mounted on two wheeled bogies. Conventional draw gear and buffers are located at each end. Additionally, you’ll also get the Class 66 Diesel locomotive in a DB red and grey livery.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b1b31dfaa1384ee425d2ff1d7da9c2df48f6e09c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/172c08fa3a1d3ed58a2777c2acbb9d85d50304e2.jpg

You’ll find the wagon is available in three conditions: Unloaded/empty, loaded with a generic tracked armed personnel carrier (APC), or loaded with a 3-axle Mine Resistant Ambush Protected vehicle (MRAP).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/55c826c0106915610471f3e9b3cd3042591dd42a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b572e0dc1c1915117f0314436947ff960aa43571.jpg

Additionally, in this pack will be Journey Mode gameplay, three new scenarios and additional timetable services for the Great Western Express and WCML: Preston-Carlisle routes

BR194 and E94 Railtour Pack from TSG

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/5daf65abf02a542a7f613f6369a9d8c79bbf5608.jpg

We’re checking back in with the TSG team this month for more information on their upcoming BR194 and E94 Railtour Pack that we announced back in April.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/8393e884066187cff4a2c829feb06a85a81ae96c.jpg

TSG: “This week, we’d like to take a closer look at the differences between the ÖBB 1020 and the BR194. While we won’t be revisiting the cab details, we do want to highlight some of the key changes on the locomotive’s exterior.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/579069afa9a7bb676ffb073d064d42950bc39e8f.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/dcbb7daa271fb4574e7cee9a4e854dfb27dab1d0.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7669cbb72574df933fbdc7a3311a7e5d074c9ab9.jpg

“We’ve already outlined the modifications, but this time we wanted to make them more visually apparent. In the image, every part highlighted in pink was built entirely from scratch for the BR194. This really emphasizes the extent of the changes from the ÖBB 1020—not just the roof and windows, but also components like cooling pipes, vents, and lights.”

“This project would not have been possible without the invaluable support of the Elektrische Zugförderung Württemberg (altbauellok.de).”
“From the very beginning, their passionate team has provided us with original drawings and answered every technical question we had. Groups like EZW are the reason these 82-year-old locomotives are still alive and running today. Without their help, we wouldn’t have been able to capture the authentic sounds or gather the detailed information necessary to recreate these locomotives so faithfully.”

“One highlight of this pack is E94 088, which is featured in its current state: a former 1020 undergoing a transformation back to its 1943 E94 configuration. Originally built in 1943, it received major modifications in 1970 to become an ÖBB 1020 and continued service until 1994. After an extensive restoration, it was brought back to operational condition in 2013 and is now proudly maintained by EZW. Today, it still runs on both railtours and regular services whenever an additional locomotive is needed.”

As a thank-you from the TSG team, a portion of their proceeds from this pack will go directly to EZW to support their continued efforts in preserving this incredible piece of railway history.
Please note, the BR194 and E94 Railtour Pack from TSG add-on will be released on Gen 9 (Xbox Series S|X & PS5) and PC platforms only.

DB BR 420 Update from TSG
The TSG team also wanted to continue the conversation for the upcoming DB BR 420 loco release, which will support gameplay on the upcoming Frankfurt S-Bahn route.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/835db9db35a6000264a9321e3fdec238ac5ed158.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/86dbc1897786738ac8660d9cdd0c83fcede1cccc.jpg

TSG: “The drivers seat is a door blocker and we managed to get that working in our loco. So, if the seat is in its normal position, you can’t really open the right cab door and this is visually recreated too, as it would be impossible to enter the cab from therein real life too. The seat is movable, and when slided to the left side, the cab door can be re-opened.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/209573b67a19c6339529e8958a103a0ee04a5cc0.jpg

“Another feature we’ve worked on, is working folding seats for AI passengers (and players of course). If an AI passenger takes a seat, the seat unfolds automatically, and likewise when standing up the seat will fold again.”

“Finally, we’ve also made some tiny visual changes in the Frankfurt S-bahn version of the cab, so the speaker panel uses an older variant now.”

We’ll continue to hear more from the TSG team and their projects in the coming months, however, now it’s time to hear more on a project we’ve not seen in a short while…

Manchester Airport Commuter from Alan Thomson Simulation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b9978ae3a176565904341841abef648e4c5a559b.jpg

We previously removed this from our roadmap graphic whilst the team worked hard to support bug fixes and performance optimisation, and today we’re excited to pull this project back into the 0-3 months category as something you can expect coming very soon from the Alan Thomson Simulation team! Let’s hear the recent development news from them:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/e74c1fec5c037a3443ac95053653dfedf88101ff.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/dd9605b51a7486836ed7105589cedbf831a5677a.jpg

ATS: “The Manchester Airport Commuter project is progressing well through QA. Timetables and layers are complete, and we’re resolving the remaining bugs at a healthy pace. We have seen massive improvements in FPS and are now finishing up the final station and OHLE fixes We’re eagerly anticipating the public release, and since this is our first project in TSW, we’re committed to making it as exceptional as possible.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/f1fa8ca2797a32c1d42c25582f7bc42de9dfc994.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/28d4214cbb3c550d71bf8a8aa10a8b63547af20d.jpg

“We greatly appreciate the community’s feedback so far, with many of the points raised already actioned in the latest build. The ATS team would like to sincerely thank the community for their patience as we navigate a steep learning curve. We're immensely proud of our first route and can’t wait for the public to get their hands on it.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/8e98eda7f18ac0c123490c1355685f31fc3b3618.jpg

Thank you to the ATS team for the update, we look forward to sharing more on this add-on when we’re able to.

Please note, the Manchester Airport Commuter add-on will be released on Gen 9 (Xbox Series S|X & PS5) and PC platforms only.

Now it’s time to see how the Just Trains team have been progressing on their upcoming loco add-ons.

Class 86 + Mk2f Coaches from Just Trains

Just Trains: “We have been very busy working on the Class 86/2 and its coaching stock. There has been a focus on the much-requested Mk1 RMB Buffet Car which is looking grand inside and out and includes both the Intercity Executive and BR Blue-Grey liveries. Inside behind the working roller blind shutter lays a true cornucopia of food and drink all being offered by the welcoming Steward.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/89b06deca2a978a5cd60b013cdca4af5811cd574.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/0e5835c54c123efb68491097a211823e8f880b34.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7d58952dd6699ee47670dd0103971f8ef8fe2d90.jpg

You can expect lots more information coming for the Class 86/2 with a full announce article landing next week.

Transport for Wales BR Class 142 'Pacer' DMU from Just Trains

Last month, the JT team revealed a new Pacer coming to Train Sim World, in its Transport for Wales livery, and featuring LED Headlights, 2 leaf Bi-Fold doors, updated door open/close operating buttons, sanding equipment fitted to aid with slippery rails, the smash glass to access emergency door handle (non-operational) and NRN (National Radio Network) and GSM-R (Global System for Mobile for Railways) antennas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/570f1359b8e142ae7a83e28ada474fd81acc74f4.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/5ef05e71532b21ff40e74fe162ab8eb6b5193c07.jpg

Development for this continues well, and we’re looking to share new screenshots and development progress with you all soon! In the meantime, be sure to read the official Just Trains blog.

Santa Fe Gameplay Pack for Cajon Pass from High Iron Simulations

Stand out amongst the desert! High Iron Simulations’s Santa Fe Gameplay Pack is continuing through development, and back in April we shared a range of 30+ new screenshots for this pack, showing the striking red Warbonnet General Electric livery of the C40-8W, and the electric blue-and-yellow Electro-Motive SD40-2. Let’s check in with their team:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/d3f40bee1e0cd900c2ace390a559b703535e2bff.jpg

HIS: “The High Iron Simulations crew is excited to be approaching the finish line on development of the Santa Fe GamePlay Pack for the TSW5 Cajon Pass route.”
“Both the featured locomotives – the Santa Fe Warbonnet General Electric C40-8W and blue-and-yellow Electro-Motive SD40-2 – have received operational refinements.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c42d8ec3267f265bf26ddb3dccdb459b8167d7e4.jpg

We’ve created and are testing a selection of five scenarios for the Cajon route which offer main line, local, and switching challenges. Together with the more than 250 train movements featured in the services timetable there will be a great range of realistic Santa Fe-era operating experiences for the user to experience on legendary Cajon Pass. Included in the timetable is also a robust Union Pacific layer employing equipment from the Sherman Hill route.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/d18de8827da38bf8dd08f12102dd3c2731a1a199.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/91e9bc49ac463f1c25cd6c1ca768edf981f36179.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/2d90ebd14a7e563018f0f1880148174ea0b61202.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/1962dea3d49a63da87e9cbfc2adb34ced855a27a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ddc03aa3575f95c41b5c9746f8d26b15e9f0d82a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/83ea8da4a60af8a17222d0b3f35d61f7dd4a5dd6.jpg

Fine a full selection of images on our May 2025 Roadmap

Introducing Grump Dog Games – A New Third Party Development Team!

We're thrilled to announce to you all yet another new TSW partner into the scene today! Let's give a warm, and possibly familiar, welcome to Liam, the founder of this new studio.

Q: Tell us more about yourself and studio!

Liam: "Hi! I’m Liam, founder of Grump Dog Games. Some of you in the community may already know me as DTG Liam."

"Gaming and trains have both been hobbies of mine ever since I was a kid. The original Railworks is what bought these 2 hobbies together for me. I used the included tools to learn how the game was made and take a shot at creating my own content, from repainting my first trains to creating my first route."

"It wasn’t until my uni days when I really started to get some of my creations out there. My final year project slowly turned into a fully-fledged game, which led to me creating Grump Dog Games and launching my game on Steam."

"Now after years of game development and using my experience from Dovetail Games I’m looking forward to creating some great addons for TSW which I can’t wait to share with you!"

Q: What is it that made you want to develop third party content for Train Sim World?

"I’ve been working at Dovetail Games for a few years now where I've spent a lot of time creating new gameplay experiences or remastering older routes. Working on these things have taught me a lot about the process of developing for TSW while also becoming more familiar the tools."

"Mixing this experience with the passion I have for the railways and gaming it felt natural to me to become a 3rd party developer. Being a 3rd party allows me to create and share content I’d like to see in TSW which I think others will also enjoy."

Q: Tell us about the project you'll be working on!

"My first project as Grump Dog Games will be a Class 43 HST farewell pack for the upcoming GWE remaster. The pack will be focused on the final days of the HST’s running along the Great Western Mainline and include a few special liveries for the Class 43 along with their respective nameplates."
"While it's too early to mention the specific liveries included, it's the perfect time to announce that DTG have re-acquired the licence for GWR! This has opened the doors for us to not only create classic liveries but also some of the special ones designed and operated by GWR."

"With GWR back in TSW, the GWE remaster on the horizon and this year being the 200th anniversary of the modern railway this pack feels like a well-timed and fitting tribute to such an iconic train and one that is a personal favourite of mine."

Q: What part of the development process are you really enjoying?

"For me my favourite parts are when I get to be most creative, both on the route building and gameplay. The gameplay is what the players experience when playing the game so getting to script and create something that you know players will enjoy is a rewarding experience. And with route building it’s adding the small details that I enjoy most. Areas or details that players may not think too much about or even notice at first but add immersion to the route and really bring it together."

Q: Any updates on the GWE remaster?

"A lot! Progress has really kicked up a notch and things are coming along great. While it’s too early to include any screenshots from my HST farewell pack I thought I’d share some community requested screenshots of the GWE remaster. It’s been a lot of fun to make, and I can’t wait for players to get their hands on it!"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/f2aa457c1cfe11bd9a605e42fb974bd8eafc73cc.jpg

Thank you Liam, we can't wait to share more about the development of your new pack, alongside the GWE Remaster, and we're thrilled to introduce you into the community officially as Grump Dog Games!

Upcoming Improvements
We’re continuing to work on regular patch updates for Train Sim World 5, addressing community raised issues and adding new improvements for content. In our next upcoming updates, alongside a range of add-on fixes we’re able to implement, we’ll be planning to release a major free update from Skyhook Games for the Midland Main Line route. Some highlights of this patch will include:
MML Route

 Added TSW5 track shadow improvements
 Added steam emission back to Ratcliffe power station
 Added Aircraft Obstruction lights to the thin chimney at Ratcliffe Power Station
 Added ‘Stay Calm’ posters at Leicester, Derby and Nottingham stations – In support of the CALM suicide prevention charity (Learn more about CALM)
 Implementing new water materials
 Improved static stock at Beeston yard
 Changed Intermodal services to be player drivable with Cargo Line Vol.3 Intermodal
 Expanded support for forthcoming Cargo Line packs

MML Class 158

 Added TSW5 Guard Mode
 Added Dynamic gangways
 Improved interior lighting
 Improved support for Free Roam consist placement and Formation Designer.
 Fixed cab gangways preventing passage when in motion.
 Fixed camera height of Secondman seat.

Class 43 HST EMT

 Improved material when wet to be consistent with the Mk3 coaches.
 Improved support for Free Roam consist placement and Formation Designer.
 Fixed ability to add decals to Mk3 coaches in the 2+6 and 2+8 livery designer options.

 
And many more route fixes and improvements! We’ll keep you updated when you can expect these improvements in our announcements.

Köln-Aachen Timetable Update for Additional Platforms

Since our release of the new Köln-Aachen timetable update for players on Steam last month, we’ve seen a range of positive feedback for the new volume of services and additional life being added into to the timetable to make it feel busier.

Our teams are looking at when we can get this update shared to players across our other platforms, including Epic games, PlayStation and Xbox. We’d usually aim to share new updates for everyone to enjoy all at once, however we want to ensure we provide a suitable amount of time for our team to complete testing and confirm that the performance for these platforms is at a level we’re confident on.

When we shared the update, we had already completed testing for the Steam platform, and whilst we had a suitable build slot of this update to be released, we felt that players could get into the content and provide us any feedback whilst we continued testing the additional platforms. Thank you all for staying patient, we’ll keep you posted once we can confirm the next update slot that we can get this free timetable update into.

Community Corner
May Monthly Mastery
May I present our latest monthly mastery challenges…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/6205b78e8fc144d9601c516d54a7cad7fe86a017.png

Get your conductor hat ready to check tickets, tidy up luggage and ensure that our passengers are looked after in this month’s set of challenges - Good luck!

TSW Tycoon – New Update! Pets, Tasks & Livery Painting!

For those of you who are fans of TSW Tycoon, towards the end of last month we also introduced some brand new updates and features you can enjoy right now for free in-game!
Update Highlights

 Unlock pets around your station
 Equip a pet and receive perks
 Added Daily Log-in tasks for tickets
 Paint and customise your station wallpaper
 Trains can be painted
 Train logos added
 "1st Stop" Badge fixed
 Additional improvements


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/3ce5580680660b9ca020eeb1193307aa1d6fbdf6.jpg

If you’ve not heard about TSW Tycoon, this is a free multiplayer experience on Roblox that allows you and a group of friends to build and run your own train stations, and drive a range of locomotives around a charming, stylised world – with easy driving controls that are perfect for all ages! Be sure to check out our TSW Tycoon website to find out more details! So far, we’ve received 10000+ positive ratings and welcomed over 2.3 million total visits! Be sure to hop in and let us know what you think, and we can’t wait to keep developing it further with our friends at the Talewind team!

Roadmap Livestream
Exec Producer Matt, and Senior Community Manager Alex will be talking about all the things we’ve featured above and answering your submitted questions in our May 2025 Roadmap livestream, starting tonight from 19:00 BST on our YouTube / Twitch channels.

[previewyoutube=m0atG7yj9hY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Cargo Line Vol.3 - Intermodal: Out Now
notes.content:
Cargo Line Volume 3 continues Skyhook Games’ series of freight-themed gameplay packs that add different freight wagons to formations and more gameplay to selected Train Sim World routes.

Cargo Line Volume 3: Intermodal
FCA Intermodal Spine Wagon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b18f71184be016c43ef68f03882da0c48f5c0d1c.jpg

This Add-on introduces the FCA Intermodal Spine Wagon to Train Sim World, as well as the 20ft container. The 40ft container and DB Cargo variant of the Class 66 seen in previous releases also form part of the pack.

The wagon consists of a main spine with multiple container locking points between two wheeled bogies. Conventional draw gear and buffers are located at one end, with a permanent connecting bar at the other for linking with a twin. These wagons feature dynamic container load so that no two trains are the same (in-game, some wagons in formations have been preselected not to be loaded).

Timetable, Scenarios and Gameplay
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b3805c814c26e70460e9d8c684605ac9325c2591.jpg

Gameplay takes place across two routes:

 West Coast Main Line: London Euston-Milton Keynes + 3x Scenarios and 21 services
 East Coast Main Line: Peterborough-Doncaster + 3x Scenarios and 12 services

Note: these services are substitutions, whereby FCA wagon Intermodal trains run in place of the native Intermodal trains seen on these routes.

WCML: London Euston – Milton Keynes is included in Train Sim World 5: Standard, Deluxe and Special Editions.

East Coast Main Line is available as a separate route Add-on.

Creators Club Tools
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ecda2bb4e825502a62a856168d85ac224b4bbe10.jpg

Both the FCA Intermodal Spine Wagon and Class 66 are supported in Livery Designer and Formation Designer, including both full and empty wagons.

The Class 66 also has Raildriver support.

A multitude of formation lengths are available to spawn in Free Roam and select in Scenario Planner.

Train Sim World 5: Cargo Line Vol.3: Intermodal is out now on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for £9.99/€11.99/$14.99

*UK pricing is £9.49 on the PlayStation Store

Cargo Line Bundle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/bac5a3f3653142ff7566d712d1eb4e3c4cfe895b.png

On Steam, players new to the Cargo Line series will be able to make use of the new Train Sim World 5: Cargo Line Collection Bundle.

This bundle features:

 Midland Main Line
 Cargo Line Vol.1: Petroleum
 Cargo Line Vol.2: Aggregates
 Cargo Line Vol.3: Intermodal


Further down the tracks... Cargo Line Vol.4: Military
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/fff9c46f87df2d2c2b480a85a75d8987ef876120.jpg

Followers of the Train Sim World Roadmap will know that Skyhook Games are working on Volume 4: Military! We’ll be sharing more news about this soon.

notes.title: Train Sim World 5 Game Update - April 28th
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our next update is now live, bringing a range of improvements across several routes. Starting with our major highlight; the Koln – Achen timetable update on Steam. This update adds new services and layers, and boosts the timetable from 552 to 4000 services, 600 of which are playable! 

We’ve made further fixes to Zwolle Groningen, including fixing multiple floating objects around the route (get down from there, sign!) and scenery improvements. We also have several updates for a range of other Train Sim World add-ons. 

As always, please allow up to 24 hours for it to fully reach your system. Be aware that some systems may update automatically.

Highlights:
Koln – Aachen (Steam Players Only)
•	Added the free timetable update for Koln – Aachen, increasing the total service count from 552 to over 4000 (around 600 of which are playable) with the relevant add-ons.
•	Added ICE T to appear as an AI train on the route.

Zwolle – Groningen
•	Fixed an issue where SNG units couldn't be uncoupled from each other.
•	Fixed multiple floating objects across the route.
•	Fixed an issue causing the overspeed 3 bell warning to play during emergency braking when using ATB on any Dutch loco.

Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn: Mannheim – Kaiserslautern

•	Added a missing overhead line at Schifferstadt.
•	Added the missing Baroque Palace for Mannheim University.

Full Changelog:

ICMm Koploper

SNG Sprinter

Thomas & Friends™

Bremen – Oldenburg

notes.title: Köln - Aachen Timetable Update - Coming Next Week!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/92494ba8b7efe0631487484109c757699c996395.jpg

New services and new layers for an old favourite! Köln - Aachen timetable updates are coming soon.

We’ve been talking about the upcoming Köln-Aachen timetable update for a little while now, coming to bolster the total service count with a huge new selection of playable and AI services.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/cf03d85559531ce7abb51e7c46093947c6c6713e.jpg

As a reminder, this will be a free update to owners of the route and Train Sim World 5. Today we wanted to confirm all the Add-ons that will add layers on to the route following the update and the roll out plan for different platforms.

As a note: the timetable update will initially be rolled out to Steam players only, with other platforms receiving the update at a later time.

The Timetable and Additional Service Layers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/32bd180f8f1b2b577e516dd31f4a324824fd385f.jpg

With all relevant content installed, the service count will go up considerably from the original 552 services to over 4000 (of which around 600 will be playable)!

Below is the full list of Add-ons that will add playable and AI services to the new timetable:

Bremen-Oldenburg

 BR110 with n-wagen services on certain AI RB48 (Köln) and RE4 (Aachen) services.

Dresden-Riesa

 Playable Zacns freight services and static Zacns wagons around the route.

Frankfurt-Fulda

 for AI ICE-T services

Hauptstrecke Rhein-Ruhr

 for the BR 422 operating S6 services and BR 425 operating RE8, RB26, RB27 (all at Köln) and RB33 (at Aachen)

Linke Rheinstrecke

 for a BR 103 railtour service

LGV Méditerranée

 TGV AI services subsituting for Thalys services between Aachen and Köln

Maintalbahn

 for the DB BR 642 DMU serving all major stations. More details can be found below.

Main-Spessart Bahn

 for the DB BR 146

Ruhr-Sieg Nord's DB BR 363

 Shunting and local services throughout the route and in yards such as Stolberg and Köln Hansaring

Salzburg-Rosenheim

 BR 111 on RE4 services at Aachen Hbf

Schnellfahrstrecke Kassel-Würzburg

 ICE 1 AI services at Köln as well as a few playable services running the full length of the route, plus ICE 3 AI services at Köln. Most freight services also come from this Add-on.

Railpool BR 193 Vectron

 Playable and AI NightJet services

FlixTrain BR 193 Vectron

 FlixTrain AI services at Köln Hbf with a few playable depot moves and two full length runs (one each way).

DB BR 101 (original Add-on)

 IC services as AI at Köln as well as a few playable services running the full length of the route

DB BR 218

 One short freight service that is bound for a diesel-only branch line

S-Bahn Köln BR 423

 The BR 423 from the New Journeys pack runs all S11, S12 and S19 services. These are all in their own layers for this timetable and do not affect the New Journeys timetable.

Hauptstrecke Hamburg–Lübeck

 static Roos-t wagons throughout the route

S-Bahn Köln BR 423

 The BR 423 from the New Journeys pack runs all S11, S12 and S19 services. These are all in their own layers for this timetable and do not affect the New Journeys timetable.


Further timetable details
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/a2577f9d6394052a6fa15298581284401aeda05e.jpg

On the New Journeys timetable, RE8 and RB27 had problems joining the mainline in the southbound direction and always ran late, causing only northbound services to be playable. This timetable has them running on time in both directions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/f072110e4871b6c9e9ebac98db8291f713827eda.jpg

In this timetable, the original RE1, RE9, S-bahn and ICE services will of course still feature. New AI services will also be seen at various stations such as Aachen Hbf, Düren and of course Köln Hbf which has non-stop activity through the day including RE7 trains.

For players with the Main-Spessart Bahn route Add-on there are additional peak-only RE1 services that run non-stop between Aachen Hbf and Düren only stopping at Stolberg Hbf. RE1 also has two services a day that stop additionally at Eilendorf.

DB BR 642 Services (from Maintalbahn)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/3fa780995ab952cada5e8772197486cc660efddd.jpg

The addition of RB20 services will allow players to serve a new station, Eilendorf Bahnhof, which is only serviced by RB20 and some peak RE services. RB20 trains also run between Langerwehe and Düren and as AI at Langerwehe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/6eea81d7a99a1944bfd438b977eda2cc15c6f002.jpg

Maintalbahn also adds:

 RB21 & RB28: AI traffic at Düren
 RB12, RE22, RB24. RB25: AI only traffic in the Köln area.
 RB38: Playable services between Köln Hbf and Horrem as well as AI only services at Horrem.


Freight services

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/d703e2ac32435ab5847de6a00993461c69a4207e.jpg

For the freight fans, the timetable now features a huge new range of services to experience mostly via the Kassel - Wüurzburg route Add-on. Freight trains will need to stop at passing points for highspeed trains or even other freight trains, and whilst most are A-B runs, there are a few shunting services for Stolberg too.

Platform roll out
The timetable update is scheduled to be rolled out initially to Steam players only, with other platforms receiving the update at a later time. This will come with the next scheduled TSW patch update, alongside a range of other improvements and fixes for various add-ons, ahead of the release of Cargo Line Vol.3: Intermodal on 1st May.

We will provide further details about the new Köln-Aachen timetable on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Epic Games players at a later time whilst our teams continue to test these platforms.

If you're a player on PlayStation 4, you may have already gotten a sneak preview of the new timetable, as this was unintentionally included on builds earlier in the month. We've not been able to further test this platform, and we will share more news for our roll out on PS4 alongside all other platforms as soon as we can. In the meantime, if you do give it a try on PS4, please be aware of any issues that you may encounter, and we welcome any thoughts you have in our Köln-Aachen Timetable feedback thread, which we will share early next week.

TSW5: Compatible Schnellfahrstrecke Köln - Aachen

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/d0ea5e8efa028245a6333afa455d43f71c7cbae1.jpg

If you're new to Train Sim World 5, you can still pick up Schnellfahrstrecke Köln-Aachen as Compatible content.

This high-speed route between two historic cities in Köln and Aachen features the DB BR 406 ICE 3M and DB BR 422 EMU, with both LZB and PZB operations. Stopping services arrive at intermediate stations such as Düren and Free Roam allows players to operate in and around the complex yard north of Köln, including the turntable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/0121bb3a6ea5871be78ae7d4590da394ba7dc609.jpg

In reality, freight is a regular feature along the route, as are S-Bahn services and depot movements between yards and stations, making it the ideal route to be updated with these additional timetabled services from the wider Train Sim World collection.

Find out more about Train Sim World 5 by following @trainsimworld on X/Twitter, Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Twitch, and TikTok.

notes.title: Cargo Line Vol.3 - Intermodal, Coming Soon
notes.content:
The Story So Far:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/40b3981fbbde033c397b13b20677c55dc63cfb40.jpg

Cargo Line Volume 3 continues Skyhook Games’ series of freight-themed gameplay packs that add different freight wagons to formations and more gameplay to selected Train Sim World routes.

Previous Cargo Line releases include:

 Cargo Line Volume 1: Petroleum (VTG TEA Tanker Wagon)
 Cargo Line Volume 2: Aggregates (HOA Bogie Hopper Wagon)


These both added gameplay to Midland Main Line and Great Western Express. Volume 2 also added services to Southeastern Highspeed and London Overground Suffragette line.

Cargo Line Volume 3: Intermodal
The Rolling Stock

FCA Intermodal Spine Wagon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/92f95068d32380f2a185823819856e4caae80ed8.jpg

New to the list of UK freight wagons available in Train Sim World is the FCA Intermodal Spine Wagon.

These were introduced to the UK in the year 2000. This fleet of approximately 400 wagons, arranged in coupled pairs, are capable of being laden with a variety of container-based loads and are found across the country. Ships bring containers in by sea, and export them abroad, but the journey between port and customer is done by rail. In Train Sim World 5, the FCA wagons feature dynamic container loads with containers of various sizes and colours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/0ef54931d648d760876626e267c0487594b9730c.jpg

Also new to Intermodal loads is the 20ft container, which is shorter in length and height than the 40ft version seen in previous releases.

The wagon consists of a main spine with multiple container locking points between two wheeled bogies. Conventional draw gear and buffers are located at one end, with a permanent connecting bar at the other for linking with a twin. These wagons feature dynamic container load so that no two trains are the same (in-game, some wagons in formations have been preselected not to be loaded).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/2791aad4195b778361c2c297628d32f54ff25b58.jpg

The pack also comes with the DB Cargo variant of the Class 66, previously seen in other Train Sim World Add-ons.

notes.title: Training Center - Easter Egg Hunt 2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/e007bd0ecd9da9a68d905af15779574a7ac4c1b2.png

The Training Center Bunny is back! It's Easter time again, and this year we're celebrating by returning our in-game egg hunt across the Training Center!

Mastery Event Egg Hunt
If starting the event anew, you will not initially be able to find the Easter bunny in Training Center, you must first unlock the mastery tile and activate it.

To unlock the event, you will need to complete any scenario or tutorial, which will then reveal the mastery tile in your Mastery Rewards Menu. Activate it and then head over to the Training Center to start the egg hunt!

There are 15 hidden eggs across the Training Center, and by finding certain amount of them you will unlock Easter-themed decal rewards. Here are the challenge tiers:

 Collect 3 eggs to unlock Easter Themed Decals.
 Collect 6 eggs to unlock Easter Egg Decals.
 Collect 12 eggs to unlock additional Easter Egg Decals.
 Collect all 15 eggs and the basket is complete - Go and check out the last egg in the basket in Reception.

Each time you collect an egg, another egg will be added to the basket in the reception area with the Easter Bunny, so you can watch as it builds up!

Event Disclaimer
As a heads-up to those who have previously started last years Easter egg mastery, the eggs will be hidden in the same positions, and due to the way our mastery tiles work, the progress you may have already made on this event will remain so you may find that the basket is already complete when enabling the tile.

You can start the event fresh, even if you've previously completed it, by creating a new player profile, and then following the above steps required to enable the tile to appear.

Training Center Easter Bunny

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7e04349bd1af3482239cf1823c5020c12a6f65e4.png

We encourage you to share your own completed egg baskets on social media, and please make sure to tag our accounts @TrainSimWorld! Why not even record the time it took you to find them all, and challenge others to do it faster?

Mastery Tile Note

Those of you who have previously unlocked the Christmas Mastery Tile, you may already see the Easter mastery appear without even completing any services, but it will be missing an icon and will do nothing if you turn it on.

This is simply a visual error, and if you play a service the real mastery tile will unlock, and you can tell because it will correctly have the thumbnail, as shown:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/35f625e7976615ebfb3c34624ac70a7d733975fc.png

Need a Hint? (Spoilers Ahead!)

We've updated our Easter Egg Hunt map, which gives hints for the locations of the eggs, without overly revealing them. Hover over the spoiler text below for a hint (but not a reveal) for the egg locations!

[spoiler]Easter Egg Hunt - Approximate Egg Locations{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/bf7270cab0d89fb758d55506b467a36f8e31aae0.jpg[/spoiler]

We hope you enjoy this event, and again share with us any images or progress you've made on our socials or in our community spaces!

notes.title: ECML Diesel Railtour Pack - Out Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/08b870af900856b2bdf52dcabe55e07e508c514d.jpg

10 Scenarios, hundreds of timetable substitutions and a unique locomotive. Athena Simulations' East Coast Main Line Diesel Railtour Pack is out now!

Rolling Stock

47484, Mk1 Coaches, Class 40 & 45 locomotives

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/02d2cb6a4a5afa8395f7de55990a64426545d747.jpg

A roster straight from the 1980s features for this Add-on, including the uniquely modelled variant of the Class 47 locomotive: no.47484 ‘Isambard Kingdom Brunel’.

This retro loco, adorned in western green, was a rare catch in the British Rail days thanks to its ornate furnishings and distinct heritage livery. Despite declining into disarray, this fallen legend springs back to life for modern railtour duty, courtesy of Athena Simulations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/6ea53c08ab35ef8f83dee814ba4c5ec971067a07.jpg

The model features custom 3D nameplates and number plates (including the unique brass BR logo) and the variations in each cab end, after the real locomotive was rebuilt following accident damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/0b4526cb6074a31481f62274d1ab8fde72a45577.jpg

Inside the cab, the locomotive’s systems reflect those present before being taken out of service. As such, more modern safety systems that would be required for running on today’s tracks are not implemented.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/01af24898752d3378347e936b1d1629e1f448598.jpg

Also included are variants of the ubiquitous Mk1 coaching stock in BR blue and grey livery. These coaches have been remodelled, coming in BG, TSO, BSO and FK variants that are both Air and Vacuum Braked.

This is the first release to include these Mk1 variants in this livery and that are Dual Braked – features that have been requested by the community to allow for versatility when creating loco-hauled railtours in Scenario Planner, Free Roam and Formation Designer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ddb5cc6c856a8e7b0a261e390fee85e3e85e64bc.jpg


For some additional action, the Class 40 and 45 locomotives previously seen in the Northern Trans-Pennine and BR Heavy Freight Pack Add-ons are included.

Players do not need to own previously released content to access these locomotives.

Scenarios – East Coast Main Line

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7949dfdccdc0d7251ae8262ab6f36d9960f8f9e8.jpg

The pack includes 10 Scenarios in total on the East Coast Main Line route Add-on.

Keen to avoid repetitive A to B Scenarios, Athena Simulations have created depot movements, run-round movements and coupling as well as double-headed formations replicating special railtours along the East Coast Main Line. Some of the Athena Simulations team followed and travelled on such rail tours in the 1980s.

Paths in some Scenarios take to the slow lines to allow main line traffic to pass by. Expect signals to hold you up as the priority is given to the faster LNER Azumas!

The Scenarios are as follows:

Brunel Comes Home
Drive 47484 Isambard Kingdom Brunel from Doncaster to Peterborough, on the first leg of a railtour to the South West.
During the journey, you will be given information about the life and career of Brunel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b37432be8ae306cf2b02503f1a3be5ad51754cb5.jpg

Taking A Peak
Drive a Class 45 from Peterborough to Doncaster on a farewell tour. Expect numerous signal checks and looping to remain clear of commuter traffic and Kings Cross expresses.

Whistle While You Work
Drive a pair of double-headed Class 40 “Whistlers” from Doncaster to Peterborough on a leg of a railtour from York to Penzance. The locos will be required to keep to a strict timetable for regular photo stops.

Scottish Brunel
47484 is performing a railtour from Inverness to London Kings Cross. Pick up the heavily delayed service at Doncaster, with stops at Grantham and Peterborough.

Isambard Comes North
47484 'Isambard Kingdom Brunel' is at Retford. Pick up 47484 at Retford and drive a northbound tour to Doncaster. On arrival at Doncaster run around your train and haul the ECS to Doncaster Depot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/6e4fe13e4911764c6b7b3fd97f34dcad1b246bb3.jpg

Peterborough Parking
Take the Class 47 from Newark to Peterborough on a southbound leg of a railtour from Sheffield. On arrival at Peterborough, you will need to both shunt the ECS to sidings and stable the locomotive.

Brunel Nights
47484 is required first thing in the morning to lead a railtour heading North out of Doncaster. Drive through the night from Peterborough with empty coaching stock to Doncaster ready for the tour to start at the crack of dawn. Expect speed restrictions and line diversions as the late night operation coincides with engineering work on the ECML.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c67e426e94fe6b3a2a6e22fd822acffaf0a7ad8a.jpg

Weather Woes
47484 is performing a tour south to London Kings Cross from Doncaster. The driving rain and poor visibility is no deterrent to the eager fans, despite making conditions difficult on the journey. Drive as far as Peterborough, calling at Retford, Newark, Grantham and Peterborough for photo opportunities in the appalling weather!

Christmas to the Cross
Take a Class 40 from Doncaster to Peterborough, on a Christmas special, with a photo stop at Grantham. Expect delays and difficult traction in this snowbound scenario.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/0ffbba77864cdef05bb4c736cd390a40d5cc925e.jpg

Double Up
Operate a Class 45 and 47484 double headed from Peterborough to Doncaster. Take the 45 and couple to the stabled Class 47 at Peterborough, before reversing onto the coaching stock and heading north to Doncaster.

Timetable Substitutions on other TSW routes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/1c78118970c74b08f85df95de6cca1d47e9dfe44.jpg

In addition, a substantial amount of work has been done to implement the railtour services into the timetables of other Train Sim World route Add-ons as timetable substitutions.

The full list of routes impacted:

 Great Western Express (Diesel Legends timetable)
 Cathcart Circle Line
 East Coastway
 Northern Trans-Pennine
 West Cornwall Local
 West Somerset Railway
 Blackpool Branches
 West Coast Main Line: Preston-Carlisle


In total, this allows the Add-on's locomotives to be substituted into some 300 timetabled services across all the above route Add-ons.

Join Jamie, Matt and the Athena Simulations team for a Launch Stream of the ECML Diesel Railtour Pack tonight, April 3rd at 8pm BST on YouTube and Twitch.

East Coast Main Line route Add-on


The East Coast Main Line route Add-on, first released in Train Sim World 4, is available as Compatible Content for Train Sim World 5 and is required for the 10 Scenarios.

This includes the LNER Class 801 Azuma and the high-speed stretch of this iconic route between Peterborough and Doncaster.

Find out more about Train Sim World 5 by following @trainsimworld on Twitter/X, Bluesky, Instagram, Threads, Facebook, YouTube, Twitch, and TikTok.

notes.title: Train Sim World 5 Roadmap - April 2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c2ba40ad673fb54b5a8bf8aed508e6a74ae46546.jpg

TL;DR (too long; didn’t read) Summary


Content Up Ahead

 New Details for Frankfurt S-bahn, now including the Frankfurt Flughafen Long Distance train station!

Third Party Partners

 New Screenshots for the DB BR 420 from the TSG team
 ECML Diesel Railtour Pack from Athena Simulations
 Announcing the ‘BR194 and E94 Railtour Pack’ from TSG
 Announcing the Transport for Wales BR Class 142 'Pacer' DMU from Just Trains
 Santa Fe Gameplay Pack Update from High Iron Simulations
 Cargo Line Volume.3 - Intermodal Update from Skyhook Games
 Mildmay line – Post-Release Updates & Future Improvements

Patches and Updates

 Train Sim World 5 Previous Patches & Upcoming Updates

Community Corner

 New Mastery Posters – Releasing Today!
 April Monthly Mastery Challenges – Live Now
 Community Spotlight: Tygerways Guides & Tutorials
 Train Sim World 5 - Coming Soon to Nvidia GeForce NOW


And just to cover the changes from the previous graphic:

 Removed BR Class 104 & Peak Forest Expansion Pack (Simtrack Studios)
 Removed Unannounced DE Loco (Simtrack Studios)


The Train Sim World Roadmap
Well, we certainly had an interesting morning of foolishness and pranks!

If you didn't catch our April Fools 2025 Roadmap, then why not take a peek now and enjoy some of the fun we had this year! Can you spot any of the subtle teasers?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b2ec22c3ae15af3885deb95b0cbecb8caeb1ccd8.jpg

If you were interesting in picking up the prestious TTC Class 66 April 1st Roadmap Livery, you can grab it for free on Creators Club.

With that said, welcome to the actual April Roadmap for Train Sim World 5, where we share insights into our progress on new content, updates and future announcements for developments from both our teams, and our range of third-party partners.

If you’re joining us for the first time, this is a monthly check-in that will continue the conversation between our teams and all of our community, and share what you can expect coming up this year for Train Sim World, from both Dovetail and our external partner teams, including brand new announcements, updates and sneak peeks on our routes in-development, as well as new ways for you to get involved with mastery rewards and upcoming events.

We're coming to an end of our Springtime Sprint event, where we lined up a whole stack of content releases, preview livestreams, platform sales and announcements all across March, but there's always more to come!

We've got brand new details and screenshots for Frankfurt S-bahn to show you all today, and our Third Party Partner section has exciting new announcements coming from both the TSG and Just Trains team, further development updates from Skyhook Games, High Iron Simulations and Athena Simulations, and exciting news from Johannes of Incredible Trains for future updates to the Mildmay line!

Be sure to also read on for more news across the community, including new Mastery Poster rewards coming in today, a Community Spotlight and more.

Enough fooling around - Let’s get into it!

Content Up Ahead
Frankfurt S-bahn: S1, S8 & S9
Let's head back to Frankfurt S-Bahn, where we are representing the S1, S8 and S9 lines of the S-Bahn Rhein-Main network, covering over 80 km and a total of 25 stations between Frankfurt am Main Hbf, including the underground (tief) platforms, to Wiesbaden Hbf.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/9bb7b4e29ee7f417bc5afee8bee60f8b8283f398.jpg

But wait, there's more!.. or should it be... 26 stations! After reviewing the community feedback, we agreed that missing out the Frankfurt Flughafen Long Distance train station would be a big miss. With some extra effort from the internal teams, we are now happy to announce, it will be part of the release version of the route.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/2aadca780f7615b22e1a90542e49c5da83b20e61.jpg

See an updated Frankfurt S-bahn route map below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b9ba7c6299dd840e60c983fc4068d72615104eec.jpg

The station mostly serves long-distance trains, which is uncommon in Germany. It has an average of one ICE every 9 minutes during peak times - equating to around 160 ICE stops every day.

This makes it one of the most-frequented long distance train stations in Germany!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/33cff3700828202e86708ff738d6630b529a2ce4.jpg

Additionally, to support this, the freight loop in Mainz will now also be in the route. Enabling trains to enter Mainz from the north after coming from Frankfurt.

The Frankfurt Airport Long Distance station opens up new types of gameplay, you will be able to drive:

 ICE3 services to Frankfurt HBF (Kassel Würzburg Route needed)
 ICE1 services between Frankfurt and Mainz (Kassel Würzburg Route needed)
 ICE-T services from Frankfurt Hbf to Wiesbaden via the Airport and Mainz. (Frankfurt Fulda Route needed)
 IC services
 S-Bahn services that in 2018 used to end in the station at night.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/02947fdee570d53ff61fbca88be3b1fc203e4e96.jpg

The Route
The route is set prior to the opening of Frankfurt Gateway Gardens, offering the chance to traverse over the original airport approach which no longer exists.

You'll be able to get a unique driving experience for each line:

S1 takes a more direct westerly route out of Frankfurt, calling at suburban locations in the outskirts of the city and running north of the Main river, the longest tributary of the Rhine, all the way to Wiesbaden.

S8 and S9 share an alternative path which initially heads south to serve Frankfurt Airport’s Regional station, before stopping at all stations on the Mainbahn, south of the Main.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/021cdad4152a995c7eeb97cf8e43ed497bc732c7.jpg

Included with the route will be the new DB BR 430, the DB BR 423 and the DB BR 143 and Dosto combination. All other services which call at Fernbahnhof will be additional layers. We'll share more details of the timetable in a future article.

DB BR 430

New to Frankfurt S-Bahn will be the hard-working DB BR 430 EMU, which operates the bulk of traffic on the S1, S8 and S9 lines. This 4-car, high-capacity EMU has been in full operation on the S-Bahn Rhein-Main since their introduction a little over a decade ago.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/29ef981a89026a8a6151c8ef18bd3c3296ef7c10.jpg

The design is reminiscent of the DB BR 422, although with more modern fittings and tweaks befitting of a busy network such as Frankfurt. The 430s replaced the much-lamented DB BR 420 and expanded the size of the fleet to offer a total of 9 trains an hour in each direction, spread across all 3 lines, with up to 12-car formations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/2b33ad8c09b0a432281b2f63588d338ae900c38b.jpg

You may have also caught a first glimpse of this, albeit in pink, in our April Fools roadmap this morning!

DB BR 423
Supplementing the BR 430 is of course the DB BR 423, a staple EMU for S-Bahn networks across Germany.

The version included with Frankfurt S-Bahn will feature a new interior to represent the S-Bahn Rhein-Main variant, as well as some physics upgrades. The BR 423 fleet is certainly no stranger to the Wiesbaden lines, although spends a majority of its time serving other destinations, making it a key part of the scene around Frankfurt Hbf.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/6cae23ee70dce24cdcffbc3b6c067e689fffcfc4.jpg

Other Traffic
Providing a regional touch is the DB BR 143 and Dosto combination, which runs RB services out of Wiesbaden. AI-only traffic such as ICE and freight will suitably layer in across the route.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/02a4387a9ddacf84f0e5e1e6471484ab8bdd6c91.jpg

Third Party Partners
New Screenshots for the DB BR 420 from TSG

Last month we re-announced the upcoming DB BR 420 Loco from the TSG team, helping support gameplay on the upcoming Frankfurt S-Bahn route. Today we wanted to share a new set of screenshots, and reminder you on all the details shared so far!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/41dabc50f02e6ad41acc29eb5c0ed6586924b63c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/9da6ddc6aa061e3c87f887a270d7b42191557e17.jpg

Get your hands on a modernised 8th series 420 with swinging doors, digital display (speedometer, LZB, PZB and such) in the cab and LED destination board. Compared to the 430, you'll notice differences inside the interiors, with changes to colours and decals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/5235f99f345e21eaf0cc0fab4309136392e5ac4e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/4bd58263fae2d5e74f15b1f4274cea5dc645f6b9.jpg

The 420 is a 3-car EMU without any walkthrough gangways and all-around represents a much more classic style of driving and riding along the S-Bahn Rhein-Main, with it being from the early 1970s.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/d38061a8e12eddc8168f0669833b5a2fc60879de.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ab2b182ccef6136cf5e2878dd511d8646e274250.jpg

The DB BR 420 will come with its own interpretation of the Frankfurt S-Bahn timetable, swapping out 430 traffic for its classic predecessor. The Munich S-Bahn BR 420 can also be used on Hauptstrecke München - Augsburg in Free Roam and Scenario Planner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/4798f25f89ec217c93d1e5d1c5cb16a8ebda58de.jpg

We'll continue to keep you updated with more details for the DB BR 420 in upcoming articles. As a note, both Frankfurt S-Bahn and DB BR 420 add-ons will be released on Gen 9 (Xbox Series S|X & PS5) and PC platforms only.

ECML Diesel Railtour Pack from Athena Simulations – Releasing This Week!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/84bffdee289fe2d2ca961fc89710b64c783b4f0d.png

Get ready to hop aboard a newly modelled variant of the Class 47 locomotive: no.47484 ‘Isambard Kingdom Brunel’, coming with new Mk1 coaching stock in BR blue and grey liveries, in BG, TSO, BSO and FK variants that are both Air and Vacuum Braked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/02d2cb6a4a5afa8395f7de55990a64426545d747.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/6ea53c08ab35ef8f83dee814ba4c5ec971067a07.jpg

In the pack, you’ll also find the Class 40 and 45 locomotives (previously seen in the Northern Trans-Pennine and BR Heavy Freight Pack Add-ons) as well as 10 scenarios on the East Coast Main Line route Add-on, featuring depot movements, run-round movements and coupling as well as double-headed formations replicating special railtours along the East Coast Main Line.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c67e426e94fe6b3a2a6e22fd822acffaf0a7ad8a.jpg

Catch railtour services in the timetables of other Train Sim World route Add-ons as timetable substitutions. The full list of routes impacted:

 East Coast Main Line
 Great Western Express (Diesel Legends timetable)
 Cathcart Circle Line
 East Coastway
 Northern Trans-Pennine
 West Cornwall Local
 West Somerset Railway


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7949dfdccdc0d7251ae8262ab6f36d9960f8f9e8.jpg

The ECML Diesel Railtour Pack releases later this week, Thursday April 3rd on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for £11.99/€13.99/$13.99

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ddb5cc6c856a8e7b0a261e390fee85e3e85e64bc.jpg

Dive into our full ECML Diesel Railtour Pack – Coming Soon article for the full breakdown.

ECML Diesel Railtour Pack - Preview Postponed

Previously we announced that we would be hosting the ECML Diesel Railtour Pack Preview following our April Roadmap livestream, however, we've had to postpone this event for tonight due to unforseen circumstances, and we will update you all via our announcements for details of when you can next expect to catch this content live with the Athena Simulations team.

We will still be hosting our April Roadmap livestream event this evening from 18:00pm BST, and you can find a YouTube event for this at the end of the article.

Announcing the ‘BR194 and E94 Railtour Pack’ from TSG!

This month, we have a new announcement coming from the TSG team, with new screenshots and information on a pack they’ve been developing featuring 2 new locos, the BR 194 and the E94 088, a new passenger coach, a new freight wagon, a new 1984 timetable and scenarios for Linke Rheinstrecke, as well as new scenarios for Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/729bac9cb37c1cb604fc38294be990ade0b2cd5c.jpg

That’s a lot to take in, here’s a breakdown of everything you can expect with the pack:

Rolling Stock:

 New BR 194 (80s version original e94)
 New E94 088 (Railtour loco)
 New B4yg Passenger Coach
 New Gbs freight wagon
 Es50 freight wagon
 Falns in DBB livery


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/1c007b172e207590662d8ceb0bcae7559780836f.jpg

Gameplay:

 New 1984 timetable for Linke Rheinstrecke (For a full experience requires layers from Mittenwaldbahn, BR218 and Niddertalbahn)
 2 x Scenarios on Mannheim Kaiserslautern for the E94 088
 2 x Scenarios on Linke Rheinstrecke for the BR 194
 E94 Railtour used in various upcoming timetables for railtour services


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/e1020c77577ef949bc7d350a43e82926b5fec79e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/9b79706f95c75a44d9d423d3286c9834e6e677a3.jpg

The TSG team also wanted to highlight the differences between their new E94 088 model, and the ÖBB 1020 from the recent Mittenwaldbahn add-on.

TSG: “When the ÖBB took on the E94s to form the ÖBB 1020s, over time they made a significant number of modernisations and improvements to the locos to keep them relevant and suit local requirements. In backdating the 1020 into the BR 194 these modifications have had to be removed leaving a somewhat cruder locomotive."

Here is a visual for the differences between the two cabs:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/3846d3c396af1a16d805e4950de593cfa9f67bb4.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/27e29a68d8246f10513459e95ce9f7b3bf42653c.jpg

These modifications are extensive and not limited to:

 Air system modifications including a weaker compressor, differing air tank capacity and locations within the system and non-centralised brake frame (Goods passenger valves and Triple Valves are located on the bogies instead of in the machine room for example)
 Train brake valves are now Knorr Nr.10 manually lapped brake valves instead of the Oerlikon FV4 Self lapping Valves.
 Indusi i54 instead of i60 (functionally the same, but no ability to change modes).
 Much more Utilitarian cab
 Different Pantographs and their control system. As modelled, we only have a single contract strip on each pantograph so both pantographs have to be raised typically. The Control of the MCB and pantos is done via a single valve in each cab, with an air valve in the Number 1 cab to select which pantograph is to be used. There is always a hand pump to be used to raise the pantograph in the event of there being no main reservoir pressure to raise it, to then allow the main compressor to run.
 Different lamp systems, instead of built into the vehicle's body, are semi-permanent lamps with red filter levers on the side to change the aspect.
 Various cosmetic changes including changes to the vents, removal of the snowploughs, roofline changes, cab windows, underframes, bonnets and more.
 Changes to the Overload system requiring the driver to go into the machine room to reset in the event of an overload being tripped
 Weaker electric brake comparative to how the 1020 was before the last update if not marginally weaker.
 Green paint!

And many more!”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/f7f047804d1f1a87ed5a413902266205b67044a6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/55ddb28f8ad25710a900d4ee219808bf05b84b5b.jpg

Thank you to the TSG team for sharing news on this exciting new pack, now we’re heading back to Wales for an exciting update…

Announcing the Transport for Wales BR Class 142 'Pacer' DMU from Just Trains

Pawb yn newid os gwelwch yn dda! - All change please!

Fancy more new announcements? Well Just Trains have got you covered, with their latest dev blog talking about development on a new Transport for Wales Class 142 loco pack! We’ll hand it over to them to share more.

Just Trains: “Croeso i'n herthygl gyntaf ar gyfer y Just Trains Class 142 TrC Pacer - Welcome to our first in-development post for the Just Trains TfW Class 142 Pacer! In this in-dev we are looking at the external areas of the bouncy Pacer!”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b03bcd43d98c71841761a52d115fecb41e9656f1.jpg

“We are very pleased to announce that we are developing the Class 142 Pacer especially for use in the Dovetail Cardiff City Network route. The Class 142 Pacer was used extensivly in the UK and specifically by Arriva Trains Wales in Wales. These Arriva DMU’s were taken over by Transport for Wales in October 2018.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/5ae18b194b4866809a3f722e81da9a5ea009b17d.jpg

“Our Pacer features the transition livery when the Arriva names and logos were removed and the TfW branding was placed over the basic underlying Arriva livery. We are supplying two versions of this, one with no TfW branding at all and the other with the TfW large side length “THE START OF A NEW JOURNEY” banner art proclaiming the transition to TfW operations.

As with many trains there are many changes and variations throughout their lives and we have incoporated these into our TfW 142 to make it time-period correct.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/4121974a2a777c34fac3fe98da5347db0ba123e4.jpg

“Aside from the debranding of the previous operator this version has LED Headlights, the 4 leaf doors replaced with 2 leaf Bi-Fold doors, updated door open/close operating buttons, Sanding equipment fitted to aid with slipery rails, the smash glass to acces emergency door handle (non operational in the sim) and on the roof are the NRN (National Radio Network) and and GSM-R (Global System for Mobile for Railways) antennas.

Byddwn yn gadael i'r lluniau wneud y siarad! - We will let the pictures do the talking!”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/24bfdfca7e10e4db163baf0efdb39f7490ee3aa6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/3ef9375cb6792de6e1499e793df575dd54ae2b8e.jpg

Thank you Just Trains, be sure to read more on their official Just Trains blog, and we look forward to sharing more about this pack coming soon!

Santa Fe Gameplay Pack from High Iron Simulations

We wanted to check back in with an update from the High Iron Simulations’ team on their continued progress of the Santa Fe GamePlay Pack for the Train Sim World Cajon Pass route. Let's hear more from the HIS team:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b395c4796d4ab623c5ee54951c13dd5c82735be0.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/acd061e31567db3cc8554d5ad936b01a90f2470c.jpg

High Iron Simulations: "We are conducting initial in-game testing to further refine the operational characteristics of the two featured locomotives, Santa Fe’s Warbonnet General Electric C40-8W and blue-and-yellow Electro-Motive SD40-2, as well as the included freight rolling stock, to provide both an enjoyable and realistic user experience."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/030d8084eef21e6f08b63dfcf1799e49ff4f34e8.jpg

"Also in testing are the Santa Fe and Union Pacific timetable layers, which are based on actual AT&SF and Union Pacific freight schedules of the early 1990s. While subject to modification, the timetables are expected to include more than 250 train movements per 24-hour period, with an accurate representation of intermodal, manifest, unit train, and local operations as well as yard switching duties. The Union Pacific layer will use equipment from the Sherman Hill route."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/f49e2af7a4975ec55f428a4930ce18d4a0c978ab.jpg

"In development, too, are the scenarios which will be included in the DLC and which will provide a range of challenging and unique operating experiences."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/6bb0c10e8935632b3c658ca5f926aa1aeda6ebc1.jpg

We look forward to sharing much more from this pack as we get closer to it's release, keep an eye out on our announcements for future updates!

An Update on Cargo Line Volume.3 from Skyhook Games

This month, we’ve also caught up with Skyhook Games on their upcoming Cargo Line Vol. 3 pack, and we’ve got a huge range of new screenshots to share!

If you're seeing this for the first time, in the upcoming pack will be a Class 66 Diesel locomotive in DB red and grey, as well as a brand new FCA Intermodal Spine Wagon in an EWS maroon livery, consisting of a main spine with multiple container locking points between two wheeled bogies. You’ll be able to get gameplay for both WCML: London Euston to Milton Keynes and ECML: Peterborough to Doncaster routes, including journey mode and 3 scenarios on both routes, and timetable services.

These wagons will of course also add more options to run freight train formations in Free Roam and Formation Designer across other routes in your collection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/ce62065cf6298f6bf111ab0e1d8cc2e761df607b.jpg

Let’s hand over to Skyhook for some background details for the pack.

Skyhook Games: “EWS invested heavily in new wagons after taking control of the UK freight sector following privatisation in the 1990s. Among these was a renewal of all intermodal vehicles including the FCA 60ft spine wagon which, while individually numbered they operate in pairs with conventional draw gear at one end and a bar connection to a mate at the other. Capable of carrying three 20ft, or two 30ft or a combination of 20ft and 40ft shipping containers, introduction of the FCA into one of the strongest freight markets on UK rail was highly successful in transforming the capacity EWS could offer.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/7155b6dd6fca8cd6caa685c8e28877bb07970e07.jpg

“While designed for shipping containers, the versatility of the common locking system used means that since introduction these wagons have been spotted carrying tanks, dry boxes, containers, and specialised commodities such as domestic waste, gypsum, and other powdered products. A total of 400 were originally built in 2001 by Thrall of York and continue in operation to this day across most intermodal flows.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/40c1963ffe8fc12a38af278d43a29952a7cf79b5.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/b7be058a27144592cfaa84cc97151b6af894bf81.jpg

“The Cargo Line Vol. 3 – Intermodal pack is now in the final stages of testing, and we look forward to getting in your hands very soon”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/0e0af11a8f0a13976263519953d7fa4a3ee49709.jpg

Thank you to the Skyhook team for the images, and you'll be able to find a wider selection shown on our Roadmap livestream this evening - find more details at the end of the article. In the meantime, is that a knock at the door?

Mildmay line – Post-Release Updates & Future Improvements

Hello everyone, we’ve seen so much love for the recently released Mildmay line last month, and we wanted to check back in with the developer Johannes from Incredible Trains:

Johannes: “It's been a month since the release of the Mildmay line DLC, and I’m thrilled to see so many of you enjoying the route! Reading your feedback and watching your experiences unfold has been incredibly rewarding. I want to thank you all for your support, and I’m committed to making the experience even better.”

“Right now, I’m working closely with Dovetail Games on post-release improvements. We are actively investigating passenger spawn issues and blurry texture problems, and these fixes are my top priority for an upcoming update. I appreciate your patience, and I’ll keep you posted as we make progress.”
“But that’s not all—From seeing all the feedback and support on the route, I am now looking into an extension between Stratford to Richmond, which would include new stations and track to explore. And the best part? This extension will be a free update for all owners of the Mildmay line add-on!”

“I can't wait to share more details with you soon. Stay tuned for further updates, and as always, happy driving!”

Thanks Johannes – we’ll share news in the future for when you can expect post-release improvements to the Mildmay line add-on

Introducing All Aboard Studios – A New Third Party Development Team!

We’re excited to announce that the TSW partner space is growing once again, with a new team called All Aboard Studios! We wanted to give you all an introduction to them so that we can start the journey with you all for their upcoming developments!

Q: Can you tell us more about your team?

All Aboard Studios: “Headed up by Dan and Kieran, we are a team built on passion, expertise, and a drive to push railway simulation further than ever before. With years of experience in both game development and the railway industry, our expert team has been behind a variety of releases for Train Sim World and Train Simulator Classic, crafting detailed routes, rolling stock, and immersive environments that players have enjoyed for years. Now, we’re bringing that knowledge, skill, and ambition into our own Train Sim World releases, and we couldn’t be more excited to share what’s coming.”

Q: What brought you to develop content on Train Sim World?

“Train Sim World is the perfect platform for us to create something truly special, offering players fresh challenges, new gameplay opportunities, and experiences that feel as close to the real railway as possible. We want to build routes that immerse players in their surroundings, trains that operate with authenticity, and content that brings something different to the table. Our focus is on delivering high-quality British railway experiences, capturing the atmosphere and character of real-world operations with the level of detail and realism that players expect.

We’re not afraid to take on ambitious projects, and we’re committed to raising the bar with everything we do.”

Q: What part of the development process are you really enjoying?

“Right now, we’re deep into development on our first independent Train Sim World project, and we can’t wait to share more in the coming weeks. Every detail, from trackwork to stations and rolling stock, is being crafted with care to ensure a truly engaging and realistic experience.

We’re incredibly excited to bring something new to Train Sim World and to challenge ourselves with projects that deliver fresh and innovative gameplay. To meet the team and stay up to date with our latest developments, head over to our website at www.allaboardstudios.co.uk or follow us on social media @all_aboard_studios. We've got a small teaser for you today, and we can’t wait to show you more as we head into summer!”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/c0f69934c8b9166b237c53d4e0e7de325963d110.jpg

We’ll keep you updated when All Aboard Studios is ready to announce their first project for TSW, in the mean time be sure to discover more about them on their website and socials!

Patches & Updates

 March 13th – Core improvements and fixes for Mittenwaldbahn, Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn and Mildmay line. West Somerset Railway also recieved a range of TSW5 standard upgrades, including updated lighting, track, signals, and new suspension for rolling stock.
 March 21st – A smaller patch to address key fixes and bring further improvements on recently released add-ons such as Thomas & Friends™, Cardiff City Commuter and Mildmay line.
 March 31st – Initial post-launch improvements to Zwolle Groningen, as well as additional improvements to Cardiff City Network and the Thomas & Friends™ add-on.


We are continuing our trend to keep up with new updates as often as we can, and our teams are always looking at ways we can improve core optimisations, help cut the volume of crashes that are occurring and do our best to reduce the impact of memory limitations, which can also cause lower texture resolutions appearing for players on console platforms.

We appreciate your patience whilst we keep working to make the experience as best as possible.

Community Corner
New Mastery Posters Rewards – Releasing Today!

Ready to spice up the walls across your favourite routes? Earlier in March we released the first of a new type of Mastery, our Mastery Posters, alongside Cardiff City Network. As of today, we’re excited to announce these posters will now be released across all TSW5 routes!

This new system will be rolling out this afternoon across all platforms. We will confirm via our Announcements Forum when this has been completed

Mastery Posters - How does it work?

You unlock the posters by completing mastery challenges as you’d normally expect, the Mastery Posters will be included in a new challenge tier for each route.

Once unlocked, there will be pre-designated areas across all TSW5 routes that the posters can appear, and they will be randomly selected from your own pool of posters - which can be configured per region. So, the more you unlock, then the more variation you will see!

You’ll be able to see which posters you have unlocked via the rewards menu. Please note, you must be logged into Dovetail Live in-game to make use of this feature.

Another month brings another set of challenges for you to earn the reward of a new April decal badge on your account!

Wait, so we don't need to complete 15,000,000 scenarios???

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157374/24fbeb58a042d2bdb6e0763abbd8c1f7fc43f666.png

Community Spotlight: Tygerways Guides & Tutorials

This month we wanted to shine the spotlight on one of the fantastic members within our community, Tygerways, who has been working hard to create a comprehensive list of tutorials and video guides for Train Sim World.

You can easily access and view all these resources on the Tygerways Website, which also has handy menu-links for all the regions in TSW!

If you're looking to explore a new region, or need some support learning new signalling systems (Especially those trying out Zwolle-Groningen for the first time!) then be sure to check them out!

Train Sim World 5 - Coming Soon to Nvidia GeForce NOW

As a final note, we're happy to announce that Train Sim World 5 will be coming to Nvidia GeForce NOW, a cloud gaming service which will allow you to stream the game from Nvidia's servers to your own personal device.

We'll let you know when this has released on the platform, but for now if you're interested in learning more, please visit the Nvidia GeForce NOW How-To-Play website.
